details: You may check MEXT YLP Program official website or apply by creating a profile on WWAH. Click on Apply Now after creating your personalized profile through registered account. You can monitor your application and receive regular updates. Register here.
Complete the official scholarship Application form by providing your Personal and Educational details. Upload your documents and doublecheck all information before submission.

Before final submission, you’ll see a summary page of your application. Double-check all details and uploaded documents. Once confirmed, WWAH will generate a complete MEXT application package, including a printable PDF and submission checklist for the Japanese Embassy or recommending authority.
Stay updated via your WWAH dashboard. Track your progress, get alerts for written tests, interviews, and embassy notifications all in one place.

Once your application is forwarded to the Japanese Embassy or Consulate, you may be asked to participate in an interview. The interview focuses on your academic goals, leadership background, and motivation to study in Japan. WWAH will help you prepare with mock interview questions and expert tips.

Once your application is forwarded to the Japanese Embassy or Consulate, you may be asked to participate in an interview. The interview focuses on your academic goals, leadership background, and motivation to study in Japan. WWAH will help you prepare with mock interview questions and expert tips.

If shortlisted by the Embassy, your documents are reviewed by the Host University. They assess your qualifications, essays, and leadership profile. Some candidates may be asked for a second interview or clarification.

Once officially selected, you’ll receive a Certificate of Eligibility and admission letter. Use these to apply for a Student Visa at your nearest Japanese Embassy or Consulate. WWAH will provide full support with the visa process, including forms, tips, and FAQs.
After your visa is approved, begin planning your journey. WWAH offers tips on accommodation, travel, and settling into your new environment.
Congratulations! You're all set to start your studies abroad. Stay connected with WWAH team throughout your academic journey for any assistance.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicants must be nationals of countries eligible for the YLP. You may check eligible countries in Applicable Courses section.
Applicant must be under 40 years to be eligible.
Must have at least 3 years of work experience as of 1st October, 2026. Preference for 5 years or more experienced individuals.
Priority will be given to applicants who have a TOEFL iBT score of 79 or higher, or an IELTS Academic score of 6.0 or higher, or other equivalent test scores.
Anyone already having a "Student" status in Japan or living there will not be considered eligible.
You must be certified as medically fit to study in Japan by a doctor, using the official health form provided.

overview: The Young Leaders' Program (YLP) is a fully-funded scholarship program. It aims to contribute in cultivating future national leaders in Asian and other countries. It was started by the Japanese Government to establish friendly relationship among various countries and to help improve policy planning. This scholarship program also paves the way of forming a network of future national leaders by improving their understanding of Japan. The YLP is one of the MEXT Scholarship Programs. You can get scholarships in Public Policy and Local Governance programs in Masters’ and PhD degrees. If you are eligible and get selected, you can get many benefits with MEXT Scholarship. To get this scholarship, you will need to pass 2 to 3 screenings that will be conducted by the Japanese embassy of the country.

overview: Graduate Scholarship Program comes under Turkiye Burslari Scholarship that includes many departments in it. For example, international students can apply for scholarships in the field of social sciences, humanities, natural sciences, and engineering. You can search for relevant courses in these fields that interest you and apply to them online through our portal. Applications for Master’s Scholarship Program are open between 10 January to 20 February. You can expect interview process around April and results around Early August. name: Chevening Scholarship

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must be a citizen of a Chevening-eligible country or territory. Not applicable if you are a British citizen.
Applicant must commit that they will return to their home country after scholarship ends for at least two years.
Applicant must hold an undergraduate degree for applying to the graduate degree.
Applicants can apply to any 3 universities and their courses, they must receive at least 1 offer letter to be eligible.

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: No Ties with UK Government, British Embassies/Council
eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant or their relatives must not be affiliated to UK government, embassies, British Council,or any other partners of Chevening (universities included) in any capacity.
Applicant must not have previously studied in the UK with any scholarship.

overview: The Chevening Scholarship UK offers fully funded graduate scholarships to scholars of various countries. If you have at least 2 years of work experience, you can apply to UK universities to receive unconditional offer letter from them. If you obtain at least one offer letter, you can be considered as a potential awardee. Check eligibility criteria and if you fulfill all requirements, you may apply for it. The deadline for Chevening Scholarship usually falls in between August to November each year. The results are announced around June for applying to the September/October intake. It offers scholarships for Master's courses with 1 year duration only. It cannot be less than 9 months or more than 12 months long.

requiredDocuments.details: These are recommendation letters provided for assessing applicant's credibility to perform. The letters must be in English or with a notorised translation.
Official degree or transcript issued by the university must be provided, both are acceptable. No translation required.
At least one unconditional offer letter from university is required for this scholarship.
Applicant must have official identification card or passport for verification.
An updated CV that lists all information about past experiences gained.
You must have a signed experience letter from your work place(s) that proves your 2 years of work experience.
All universities can ask for IELTS or an equivalent test result with specified minimum score for getting the admission.
Some universities may ask you to send a letter of motivation that states your reasons for choosing UK for higher studies in a detailed essay.

You need at least a 2:2 undergraduate degree. UK applicants can also apply with 40 Level 6 academic credits and relevant prior experience, but this option is not available for international students.

You'll need at least a 2:2 honours degree in a public health-related science from a UK university or equivalent, or relevant qualifications and experience (assessed and potentially interviewed by the Programme Leader). International students need the same or an equivalent, and an IELTS score of 6.0 or higher if English isn't their first language.

name: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program

details: You may check Joint Japan/World Bank official website or apply by creating a profile on WWAH. Click on Apply Now after creating your personalized profile through registered account. You can monitor your application and receive regular updates. Register here.

Before applying for the scholarship, you must apply to one of the JJ/WBGSP approved master’s programs listed in the Applicable programs section.
Make sure you choose a program outside your home country and country of residence and obtain an unconditional Letter of Admission (only financing may be pending). This admission letter is mandatory to proceed with your scholarship application.
Complete the Application form by providing your Personal and Educational details. Upload your documents and doublecheck all information before submission.
Stay updated via your WWAH dashboard. Track your progress, get alerts for written tests, interviews, and embassy notifications all in one place.

If shortlisted, you’ll be contacted via your WWAH dashboard and email. Selection is based on: Work experience and development impact, Academic background, Recommendation quality, Commitment to returning and contributing to your country’s development. Successful applicants will be assigned to a university and awarded the JJ/WBGSP scholarship.

Once selected, you’ll receive a scholarship award letter and visa instructions. WWAH will help you gather all required documents and submit your student visa application to the relevant embassy or consulate.
After your visa is approved, begin planning your journey. WWAH offers tips on accommodation, travel, and settling into your new environment.
Congratulations! You're all set to start your studies abroad. Stay connected with WWAH team throughout your academic journey for any assistance.

benefits: Air Fare for Arrival and Departure (once)

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must belong to one of the developing countries approved for JJ/WBGSP scholarships.
Applicant can't hold dual nationality of any developed country.
Bachelor's or equivalent degree earned at least three years before time of application.
At least 3 years of full-time working experience in a development-related sector.
An unconditional acceptance letter (except of funding) from at least one of the universities participating in the JJ/WBGSP.

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Rejected or Not Completed Previous JJ/WBGSP Scholarship
eligibilityCriteria.details: Anyone who has rejected or not completed one of previous JJ/WBGSP scholarships.

overview: The Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program offers scholarships to individuals from developing countries to continue higher studies that can help their career in development studies. This scholarship requires 3 years of working experience at least as well as a bachelor's degree. It has two application windows: 1. 13 January to 28 February, 2025 and 2. 25 March to 23 May, 2025. For acquiring this scholarship, you need to reach out to specified universities and if one sends an unconditional acceptance letter (exception for Finance), you may apply for JJ/WBGSP scholarship. Make sure the eligibility criteria is met because no exceptions will be made for them.

requiredDocuments.details: One application form sent through the online portal (only after attaching UNCONDITIONAL Acceptance Letter.
Two recommendation letters from someone who has direct knowledge of applicant's work experience.

requiredDocuments.document: Document with Proof of Work Experience
requiredDocuments.details: A signed letter with company letterhead to JJ/WBGSP Secretariat that has your starting date and current designation. If more than one organizations, provide similar letter from all.
A bachelor's degree or diploma must be submitted. No transcripts are allowed as a replacement.

You must follow the format provided and write it in English or in the language of the master's degree program you are applying to.Include only paid work under employment.Unpaid work (internships, volunteering) should go under a separate “Volunteer Work” section.

name: Türkiye Bursları: Art Scholarship Program

details: You may check Turkiye Burslari official website or apply by creating a profile on WWAH. Click on Apply Now after creating your personalized profile through registered account. You can monitor your application and receive regular updates. Register here.
Complete your Personal and Educational details. Upload your documents and doublecheck all information before submission.
Once your application is submitted, you can monitor its progress through your personalized WWAH dashboard. Stay informed with real-time updates and notifications.
Applications that meet the basic requirements are checked for completeness, then evaluated based on your grades, portfolio, motivation letter, and recommendation letters.

Before the interview, eligible bachelor's candidates must take a quantitative assessment test consisting of 30 multiple-choice questions to be completed in 60 minutes. The test covers Mathematics, Geometry, and Logical Reasoning, and is available in English or Turkish. Its purpose is to assess the candidate’s analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Before the interview, eligible bachelor's candidates must take a quantitative assessment test consisting of 30 multiple-choice questions to be completed in 60 minutes. The test covers Mathematics, Geometry, and Logical Reasoning, and is available in English or Turkish. Its purpose is to assess the candidate’s analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Shortlisted candidates are invited for an interview, which may include discussions about their artistic background and aspirations.
Successful candidates receive a scholarship offer, including placement in a university and program aligned with their preferences and qualifications.

Once you’re awarded the Türkiye Scholarship, you will receive a visa support letter or guidance on how to apply for a student visa. Students must apply for a Turkish student visa at the nearest Turkish embassy or consulate using their scholarship award and university acceptance letters. If students require guidance during the visa application process, they are welcome to reach out to WWAH for assistance.
After your visa is approved, begin planning your journey. WWAH offers tips on accommodation, travel, and settling into your new environment.
Congratulations! You're all set to start your studies abroad. Stay connected with WWAH team throughout your academic journey for any assistance.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicants from all countries can apply except Turkish citizens.
Applicants must have previous education degree(s) for relevant degree they apply for.
Applicant must have 70% grade for Bachelor's degree, 75% grade for Master's and PhD at minimum.
The age limit is 21 for Bachelor's, 30 for Master's, and 35 for PhD.

overview: Art Scholarship Programme offers fully funded scholarships to international students who are interested in the fields of music, fine arts, and performing arts. This scholarship is provided at undergraduate, graduate, and PhD levels. It is only offered at select universities in Türkiye, that includes: Ankara Music and Fine Arts University, Ankara Hacı Bayram Veli University and İstanbul Technical University. The applications for the Art Scholarship Programme are taken between 10 January to 20 February. Every year, applicants can apply for this scholarship within this mentioned period.

requiredDocuments.details: Photograph of the candidate must be taken within the last 1 year.
Any nationally-recognized exams you have taken in your home country (i.e matriculation, intermediate, O & A levels).
Any previous record of education/certificates

If applying for Bachelors, academic transcripts of 10th and 12th class is required. If applying for Master, academic transcripts of 10th, 12th and bachelors degree is required. If applying for PhD, academic transcripts of all previous education is required.
GRE, SAT, etc. results required by the program/universities
TOEFL, DELF, or other language test as required by program
The research proposal topic you wish to pursue as well as written example of research you have worked on before.
Applicant must have C1 Level Certificate in Turkish or be able to reach it by the end of academic year with the Language Course offered in Program.

A letter of intent focuses on your intent to pursue a specific program, explaining why you are interested in it, how it aligns with your goals, and what you hope to achieve.Reach out to WWAH advisor for professional guidance in writing your letter of intent to make your application stand out.

One of the key documents needed for a university application is a recommendation letter. Usually, two or three letters from teachers, professors, or employers who can attest to your academic abilities and character.
For creative courses such as art, design, and architecture, you may need to submit a portfolio showcasing your work.

name: Türkiye Bursları: Merit Scholarship Program

details: You may check Turkiye Burslari official website or apply by creating a profile on WWAH. Click on Apply Now after creating your personalized profile through registered account. You can monitor your application and receive regular updates. Register here.
Complete your Personal and Educational details. Upload your documents and doublecheck all information before submission.
Once your application is submitted, you can monitor its progress through your personalized WWAH dashboard. Stay informed with real-time updates and notifications.
Applications that meet the basic requirements are checked for completeness, then evaluated based on your grades, portfolio, motivation letter, and recommendation letters.

Before the interview, eligible bachelor's candidates must take a quantitative assessment test consisting of 30 multiple-choice questions to be completed in 60 minutes. The test covers Mathematics, Geometry, and Logical Reasoning, and is available in English or Turkish. Its purpose is to assess the candidate’s analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Shortlisted candidates are invited for an interview, which may include discussions about their artistic background and aspirations.
Successful candidates receive a scholarship offer, including placement in a university and program aligned with their preferences and qualifications.

Once you’re awarded the Türkiye Scholarship, you will receive a visa support letter or guidance on how to apply for a student visa. Students must apply for a Turkish student visa at the nearest Turkish embassy or consulate using their scholarship award and university acceptance letters. If students require guidance during the visa application process, they are welcome to reach out to WWAH for assistance.
After your visa is approved, begin planning your journey. WWAH offers tips on accommodation, travel, and settling into your new environment.
Congratulations! You're all set to start your studies abroad. Stay connected with WWAH team throughout your academic journey for any assistance.

benefits: One-off Flight Ticket (at starting and ending)

eligibilityCriteria.details: A minimum General Weighted Average (GWA) of 90% is required for eligibility across all levels of study—Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD programs

For the Bachelor’s program, applicants must have a minimum SAT score of 1400 (with at least 680 in Math) for engineering departments or 1350 for other departments. Alternatively, an International Baccalaureate (IB) score of at least 33 is accepted, with at least one subject taken at the Higher Level (HL) relevant to the applied program.

For the Master’s program, applicants must score at least 80 in ALES Quantitative for engineering, or 75 for science and other departments. GRE scores of 155 for engineering or 153 for other fields are also accepted.

For the PhD program, the minimum ALES Quantitative score is 85 for engineering, and 75 for science and other departments. GRE alternatives require a score of 160 for engineering or 157 for other fields.
TOEFL IBT 80 or IELTS 6.5 score for Bachelors and TOEFL IBT 90 or IELTS 7.0 for Masters or PhD.

Gold, Silver, or Bronze medal holders from international olympiads recognised by the Scientific and Technological Research Council of Türkiye (TÜBİTAK). It includes International Mathmetical Olympiad, International Physics Olympiad, International Science Olympiad, International Olympiad in Informatics, International Astronomy and Astrophysics.

overview: Merit Scholarship Programme is a scholarship under Türkiye Burslari Scholarships Program. It is awarded to students who have achieved the highest scores in international exams, competed and won in International Olympiads, or have overall topped in their previous educational exams. This scholarship has been reserved for students with exceptional record only. It is given on Bachelors, Masters, and PhD level students. You also need English Proficiency Test Result (TOEFL or other equivalent results). In this scholarship, applicants will get twice the amount in monthly stipend than the other regular scholarships offered in Türkiye.

One of the key documents needed for a university application is a recommendation letter. Usually, two or three letters from teachers, professors, or employers who can attest to your academic abilities and character.

name: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship – Research Students

details: You may check MEXT Japan Scholarship official website or apply by creating a profile on WWAH. Click on Apply Now after creating your personalized profile through registered account. You can monitor your application and receive regular updates. Register here.

Complete the MEXT Research/Graduate Scholarship form by entering your Personal, Educational, and Research-related details. Upload required documents such as academic transcripts, degree certificates, research plan, and recommendation letters. Double-check all entries before proceeding.

Before finalizing, you’ll be shown a summary of your application. Carefully review all entered details and uploaded documents. Once confirmed, WWAH will compile your complete application package, including your research proposal and academic documentation. You’ll receive a downloadable PDF and checklist to print and submit to the Japanese Embassy as required.
Stay updated via your WWAH dashboard. Track your progress, receive alerts for document screening updates, interviews, embassy notifications, and other requirements.
Document Screening & Interview (First Screening)

The First Screening for the MEXT Research/Graduate Scholarship is conducted by the Japanese Embassy and includes document review, Japanese and English language tests, and an interview. Applicants must show strong academics, a clear research plan, and sufficient language skills for research in Japan. The interview assesses motivation, university awareness, and communication ability. English test exemptions may apply for certain countries. Passing this stage does not guarantee the scholarship but allows progression to the Second Screening and university placement.
WWAH will notify you of interview dates and assist with sample questions and personalized preparation tips.

The First Screening for the MEXT Research/Graduate Scholarship is conducted by the Japanese Embassy and includes document review, Japanese and English language tests, and an interview. Applicants must show strong academics, a clear research plan, and sufficient language skills for research in Japan. The interview assesses motivation, university awareness, and communication ability. English test exemptions may apply for certain countries. Passing this stage does not guarantee the scholarship but allows progression to the Second Screening and university placement.

After passing the embassy’s first screening, you will contact Japanese universities to obtain “Letters of Acceptance” from professors in your intended research field. WWAH will guide you through this outreach process, including drafting emails and refining your research proposal.
Once you receive at least one Letter of Acceptance, you must submit it to the embassy within the given deadline. This enables your final nomination to MEXT.

After passing the embassy’s first screening, you will contact Japanese universities to obtain “Letters of Acceptance” from professors in your intended research field. WWAH will guide you through this outreach process, including drafting emails and refining your research proposal.

After the First Screening, MEXT conducts a Second Screening and selects applicants based on their screening results and university placement status. Those with letters of provisional acceptance are usually placed at one of their preferred universities listed in the Placement Preference Form. National universities may be prioritized due to budget limits. If accepted into a regular graduate course, applicants may directly enter it. Those lacking sufficient Japanese may undergo a 6-month preparatory language course.
WWAH will keep you informed of your placement status and guide you through next steps until your university assignment is confirmed.

Upon receiving your official acceptance and placement documents, apply for a “Student” visa at your local Japanese embassy or consulate.
WWAH will offer full visa guidance and be available for questions or concerns throughout this process.
Upon receiving your official acceptance and placement documents, apply for a “Student” visa at your local Japanese embassy or consulate.
After your visa is approved, begin planning your journey. WWAH offers tips on accommodation, travel, and settling into your new environment.
Congratulations! You're all set to start your studies abroad. Stay connected with WWAH team throughout your academic journey for any assistance.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicants must have the nationality of a country that has diplomatic relations with Japan.
Applicant must be born on or after April 2, 1991 (exceptions for applicants with serious circumstances like military service, conditions of war etc)
Applicant must be willing to learn Japanese language.
Applicant must provide proof of health that they are clear to travel and study.

eligibilityCriteria.detail: Bachelors or Masters Degree (for application of Masters and Doctorate Degree respectively)

overview: The MEXT Graduate Scholarship for Research Students is reserved for individuals who are looking to or are already enrolled in any Master's or PhD program, to gain higher studies. The MEXT scholarships have 2 screenings in which you must pass to get a chance to study there. You can apply at Japanese embassy to know the rules and regulations of your particular programs and dates to apply/submit documents within. You are allowed to choose and apply to your three preferred universities and get up to 2 provisional acceptance letters. This research scholarship is includes duration of 2 to 3 years, according to the course and degree selections. You can apply for any department other than Traditional Entertainment Arts or Subjects that require practical trainings in techniques or technologies at companies or factories. Health sciences students cannot practice or participate in clinical trainings without License from Relevant Ministery

requiredDocuments.document: All original documents requested will not be returned. You are suggested to get re-issued documents for application.

Original degrees of academic studies you have undertook with 2 copies
Provided form filled and signed by a medical health professional (1 original with 1 copy)
A paper stating all abstracts of researches you have participated in along with 2 copies
For English or Japanese Language Proficiency Test taken within 2 years (3 copies)

requiredDocuments.details: One of the key documents needed for a university application is a recommendation letter.It can be from either a class teacher or principal of last school attended (1 original in free format with 1 copy).You may download the format. Any format is acceptable; this is just a sample for reference.

benefits: Monthly Stipend of HUF 43,700 for Bachelor's and Master's Degree
Monthly Stipend of HUF 140,000 (first phase) and HUF 180,000 (second phase) for PhD Degree
Free Dormitory or Accommodation Contribution of HUF 40,000
Health Insurance worth HUF 65,000 per person/a year
Chance to Experience New Place and Culture

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must be a resident of any other country except Hungary.
Candidates must have completed intermediate before 01 August, 2026 for applying to Bachelor’s or One Tier Master’s program. Final degree and transcript must be submitted as proof.
Candidates must have completed Master’s/MS/MPhil before 01 August, 2026 for applying to the PhD program. Final degree and transcript must be submitted as proof.
Applicants enrolled in the last year of their existing study programs/degrees and result awaiting candidates are allowed to apply.
The applicant must fill all the fields of the application forms to Hungary scholarship and HEC. Incomplete forms will not be considered.

Attestation of educational documents is not required at the initial stage of the process. After the applicant has been nominated, certificates/transcripts/degrees to be attached must be attested by the attesting authorities such as IBCC and HEC. Equivalence of O & A level from IBCC is mandatory for Bachelor's and One-Tier Master's degree.

Some Hungarian universities may require IELTS/TOEFL scores, whereas most of the institutions require English proficiency certificate for the admissions (attained from your respected college or universities).
All awarded applicants must submit medical certificate (issued not earlier than November 01, 2025) of satisfactory health condition. Template provided.

In case of final selection, applicants will have to submit a bond on legal paper to HEC that he/she will not change discipline after final award of scholarship, and immediately after completion of his/her degree, he/she will return to Pakistan to serve the country for a period as prescribed by the HEC. In case of failure to do so, HEC reserves the right to recover from candidate or his/her guarantor, a penalty amount as prescribed/decided by the HEC.

All applicants are required to provide HAT (for undergraduate) or USAT (for postgraduate) test scores. Applicant must have obtained a minimum score of 50% out of total marks in HAT or USAT test. The test validity for HAT is 02 years and USAT is 01 year. For this scholarship, applicant must have already obtained a valid HAT (score obtained on or after January 15, 2024) or USAT score (score obtained on or after January 15, 2025).

overview: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship is a fully-funded government scholarship that funds Bachelor's, One Tier Master’s (combination of Bachelor’s and Master’s into one), Master’s, and PhD degrees for international students. Hungary offers this scholarship with assigned partners across the world; for Pakistan, it is HEC. This scholarship offers numerous benefits such as full tuition fee coverage, monthly stipend of HUF 43,700 for Bachelor's and Master's, while HUF 140,000 (first phase) and HUF 180,000 (second phase) for PhD Degree. It also includes free dormitory or accommodation contribution of HUF 40,000, health insurance worth HUF 65,000 per person in a year, as well as a chance to experience new culture. The deadline for this scholarship usually falls in January each year.

requiredDocuments.document: Application Form(s) for Hungary and HEC
requiredDocuments.details: Applicants must fill out both HEC and Hungarian application forms.
A recent photo of the applicant (taken not earlier than 2 years before the submission of the application) is also required.
A motivation letter explains why you wish to study the course you applied for; your motivation behind it. Minimum 1 page, typed with Times New Roman 12-point font size letters.

Scanned copy of the original proof of language proficiency, with a minimum level determined by the Host Institution. In case the student has completed his/her previous level of studies in the language of the selected study programme, a proof can be uploaded (certificate from previous education institution). Add translation, if required.
Scanned copy of the original education certificate (that you have studied previously). Add translations, if required.

Copy of the original transcript of records regarding all academic semesters or school years completed during previous studies (in the highest level of education that the student have participated in). Add translations, if required.
Scanned copy of a medical certificate of satisfactory health condition, signed by a physician. Issued not earlier than 15 November 2024. Template provided.
Scanned copy of that page of the passport which contains the personal data of the applicant.
Applicants are required to provide HAT (for undergraduate) or USAT (for postgraduate) test scores, with a minimum score of 50% out of total marks.

Research plan indicates the research you plan on undertaking during your studies. It is detailed plan of how you will go through with it. Minimum 2 pages, typed with Times New Roman 12 point font size letters, written in the language of the selected study programme. Mention the resources used for it as well in the document.

A signed Letter of Recommendation from the applicant’s former or current academic tutor or supervisor, who has a scientific degree and has an insight into the professional work of the applicant, the letter of recommendation must be written in the language of the selected study programme or in Hungarian.

requiredDocuments.document: Statement of the Supervisor (for PhD only, if required by the proposed Doctoral School)
requiredDocuments.details: A statement by the supervisor at the proposed Host Institution declaring that the supervisor undertakes to supervise the student's work within the doctoral programme (if required by the doctoral school).
Candidates applying for arts or music subjects will need to submit their portfolios with the application as well.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicants must have already applied for admission to a first year of full-time or part-time on campus or distance PhD study at the University of Edinburgh.
Applicants must have outstanding academic merit and research potential. A UK first class or 2:1 honours degree at undergraduate level or the international equivalent is preferred.
The University generally does not consider candidates who have already obtained a PhD, or formal equivalent, as a result of direct research training.
These awards cannot be held concurrently with fully-funded scholarships but can be held with partially-funded scholarships and will be reduced pro-rata.

overview: The University of Edinburgh offers fully-funded Edinburgh Doctoral College Scholarships for PhD students. Applicants can study any PhD program with this scholarship in full-time, part-time, on-campus, or distance learning programs. A full-time course may take 3 to 4 years for completion and part-time courses may go on for 6 to 7 years. Note: Applicants who are applying to the School of Informatics or Physics & Astronomy do not need to apply for the scholarship. Their applications will be automatically assessed for scholarship when applying for the course. Benefits of this scholarship include university tuition fee coverage, stipend based on UKRI stipend rate (£19,237 for 2024/25), research opportunities with great facilities and chance to work with mentors and professionals. The deadline for Edinburgh Doctoral College Scholarship is in February, 2026. It is applicable for September, 2026 and January, 2027 intake.

requiredDocuments.details: Applicants are required to submit a personal statement of 3500 characters maximum that elaborates on why they should be considered for the scholarship.

The English Language proficiency test must be taken for getting admission to the course and availing scholarship. It can be IELTS, TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, Trinity ISE, Oxford ELLT, or CAE/CPE test result according to the minimum requirement for relevant courses.
The degree certificates of all previous degrees obtained will be required for University admission, same information will be used for getting the scholarship.
Transcripts of all previous degrees obtained will also be required for University admission, same information will be used for getting the scholarship.
It is an integral part of admission process. Applicant must submit a clear and distinct research proposal that includes their future plans of taking it forward and bringing results.
Applicants also need 2 letters of recommendation from their academic supervisors, professors, or other relevant personnel who have taught them before.

overview: Each year Gates Cambridge offers fully and partially-funded scholarships to outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK to pursue a postgraduate degree (Master’s or PhD) in any subject available at the University of Cambridge. Approximately two-thirds of these awards will be offered to PhD students, with approximately 25 awards available in the US round and 55 available in the International round. Gates Cambridge Scholarship offers many benefits including, tuition fee coverage (varies for each student), maintenance allowance for full course duration, one round-trip airfare, and inbound visa cost (including immigration health surcharge). These are the basic benefits, but, upon request, you may be able to get additional funding approved for academic development fund for attending additional courses or conferences (between £500 to £2,000), dependent children allowance, fieldwork allowance (for maintenance only),  maternity/paternity funding (up to 6 months), and hardship funding for facing any unforeseen circumstances. The deadline for Gates Cambridge Scholarship is usually in October for US round and in December or January (dependant on course) for International round.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must have received an offer from the University of Dundee. For Undergraduate, all programs from School of Medicine or School of Dentistry are excluded.
The applicant must hold International Fee Status as determined by the University of Dundee to be eligible. It will be communicated in the Offer letter.

overview: Global Citizenship Scholarship is a partially-funded scholarship for Undergraduate and Graduate level. It is provided by the University of Dundee, where students can study from professional faculty members with vast knowledge base. The scholarship has many benefits including, £4,000 tuition fee waiver for each year of study which means that it can provide support for up to 5 years. It promotes inclusion and diversity, provides networking opportunities, and even allows limited combination with selective scholarships. It is open for a wide range of programs, only excluding School of Dentistry and Medicine courses for Bachelor’s. The deadline for Global Citizenship Scholarship is 29 August, 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: Submit a copy of valid passport information page that includes your details and photo on it.
Scanned copies of your degree(s) and transcript(s) that you have acquired till date. Attach English translation of documents too (if required).
An IELTS 6.0 band at least or another equivalent language proficiency test according to the course requirement.
Applicant also needs to send a brief personal statement that states their reasons for joining the chosen course and how they can use these studies to make a good career for themselves ahead.
Applicants need one reference letter from a professor or academic and one from an employer. The reference letters should shed light on applicant’s skills and competence.
A complete CV which includes employment, education, and other relevant extra-curricular activities that support the application.

overview: The Government of Ireland - International Education Scholarship  (GOI-IES) is a fully-funded government scholarship for international students who have gotten an admission in one of the eligible universities. You can apply for a one-year scholarship award in Master’s, PhD, or postgraduate diploma within this scholarship. The eligible universities include: Atlantic Technological University, CCT College, Dublin Business School, Dublin City University, Dún Laoghaire Institute of Art, Design and Technology, Dundalk Institute of Technology, Griffith College, ICD Business School, Independent College, Mary Immaculate College, Maynooth University, Munster Technological University, National College of Art and Design, National College of Ireland, RCSI University of Medicine and Health Sciences, South East Technological University, Technological University Dublin, Technological University of the Shannon: Midlands Midwest, Trinity College Dublin, University College Cork, University College Dublin, University of Galway, and University of Limerick. GOI-IES provides benefits such as €10,000 stipend to help students with the costs of rent or groceries etc. It also provides a full fee waiver for one year of study. The deadline of the GOI - International Education Scholarship is in March, 2026.

requiredDocuments.details: Applicant must have received an admission offer or conditional offer letter from an Irish University. You may attach a scanned copy, email, or screenshot from a legitimate source.
Recommendation or reference letters from 2 referees. Those could be academic or professional references.
A statements that showcases your academic and professional achievements, goals, reasons for choosing Ireland as a studies destination.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Bachelor’s and Master’s degree for Master’s and PhD degree respectively. Proof must be provided.

Applicant must have proven social commitment and political interest to be considered for the scholarship.

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Solid Arguments for Applying to the Scholarship
eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant should have convincing reasons for applying to (and believing that they deserve) the Heinrich Böll Scholarship.

overview: Heinrich Böll Scholarship is a fully-funded government scholarship in Germany. Students from all disciplines can apply for full-time study at a state-recognized university and get this scholarship for Master’s or PhD. The benefits include: monthly scholarship payment of €992 for Master’s and €1400 for PhD, various individual allowances, €100 mobility allowance (for PhD candidates), and funds for limited periods if studying requires going back to home or another country. The deadline for Heinrich Böll Scholarship comes twice in one year; 1 March and 1 September. The current applications open on July 15, 2025, and close on September 1, 2025.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Along with application to KHS, you must apply and get admission in Stanford University. You may apply in any Master's or PhD course except for Honors Cooperative Program, Master in Liberal Arts, Doctor of Science of Law, and Master of Legal Studies.
Applicant must have completed an ungraduate degree in 2019 or after. Applicant currently studying must have completed the degree by September 2026 to be considered eligible.

overview: Knight-Hennessy Scholars is a fully-funded private scholarship that is offered exclusively at Stanford University. You can study any Master’s and PhD course at the Stanford University while getting up to 3 years of funding from KHS (your program may be shorter or longer than that). Each year, up to 100 applicants are selected after careful consideration to study at Stanford. This scholarship includes many benefits, such as covering full tuition fee and its associated fees, a stipend for living and academic expenses (includes room and board, books, instructional material, academic supplies, local transport, and reasonable personal expense), travel stipend (that covers an economy-class round-trip ticket for an annual visit home), along with a one-time relocation stipend, and opportunity to apply for supplemental funds for conference travel in 2nd and 3rd years of study, or for another graduate program you wish to take up at Stanford (subject to approval). The deadline for Knight-Hennessy Scholars is 8 October, 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: Fully completed application form of Knight-Hennessy Scholarship.
Applicant must include all academic transcript(s) of previous studies. It could be official or unofficial document.
A one-page CV that indicates all your work, academic, and other relevant achievements in life.
2 recommendation letters which will be filled by the recommenders when a link is sent to them to write their recommendation.
Applicant will be asked to submit answers of a few questions and an essay, as part of the application.

KHS does not require English Language Proficiency Test. However, if your course outlines it as an admission requirement, you must send your English Language Proficiency test results (TOEFL recommended) in the application.

The general application needs statement of purpose of 1000 words max that states why you chose the course or field to study along with your future aspirations (where your studies will help you reach). Each course may have specific requirements.

benefits: Economy-Class Flight Ticket (Once; at arrival and departure)
University Dormitory Accommodation and Monthly Allowance of KRW 1,200,000 per month
Settlement Allowance of KRW 600,000 for Master’s and KRW 1,200,000 for PhD (once)
Full Tuition Fee Coverage as well as part of expenses for study visits, workshops, Korean language classes and other extra curricular activities
National Health Insurance of approx. KRW 81,000 per month as well as Private Medical Insurance for unexpected accidents, etc.(benefits may differ for each case)
Scholarship Completion Grants (paid once upon departure) of KRW 300,000 for Master’s and KRW 600,000 for PhD

eligibilityCriteria.details: All applicants must be citizens of the specified countries (Success Chances automatically check it).
All applicants must be government officials and receive official nominations from their respective governments for the KOICA Scholarship program.

All applicants must be in good health, both mentally and physically, to study in Korea for the full duration of the program. Applicants with disabilities, but in good mental and physical health, are also eligible to apply.

For Master’s, applicants must have a Bachelor’s degree with 2 years of work experience in the same field. For PhD, applicants must have a Master’s degree with 3 years of work experience in the same field.
Applicants must have a strong command of English, both in speaking and writing.

overview: KOICA Scholarship is a fully-funded government scholarship for international students who wish to contribute to the socio-economic development of their countries. For this scholarship, a few select universities are offering a total of 8 courses (5 Master’s and 3 PhD). In this scholarship, the applications are first sent to the Korean Embassy. Then, embassy forwards the application to the university where we will apply for the university course. Then, original documents are requested by the embassy for final check. This scholarship has many benefits including economy-class flight ticket at arrival and departure of the scholar, one-time settlement allowance of KRW 600,000 for Master’s and KRW 1,200,000 for PhD, university dormitory accommodation, monthly allowance of KRW 1,200,000 per month, full tuition fee coverage as well as part of expenses for extracurricular activities such as study visits, workshops, Korean language classes, etc., national health insurance of approx. KRW 81,000 per month as well as private medical insurance for unexpected accidents, etc. One unique benefit of this scholarship is that it offers scholarship completion grants, which are paid once upon departure, worth KRW 300,000 for Master’s and KRW 600,000 for PhD. The deadline of KOICA Scholarship, South Korea is in July, 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: A comprehensive scholarship application form must be completed and sent to the South Korean Embassy/Representative for advancing further.

Applicant must share a photocopy of the valid passport (till 6 months after the date of departure from South Korea).
University may ask for a statement of purpose or a self-introduction form that indicates your interest and why you are choosing to study the selected courses in South Korea.
A research proposal and/or study plan that states your research interests which you will pursue during studies.
Complete resume or CV which details your prior education, work experiences, and other achievements.
2 recommendation letters from professors, teachers, or supervisors who can attest to your character, skills, background, etc that are required for further studies.
Applicants must have all applicable academic transcripts, which will be requested in original copy if you reach further in the application process.
Applicants must have all applicable degree certificates, which will be requested in original copy if you reach further in the application process.
Applicants may require IELTS (5.5 band), TOEFL, or TOEIC etc., if required by the university/course as required.
The university also requires an employment verification from your employers to authenticate your work experience.

overview: McCall MacBain Scholarship is a fully-funded private scholarship. It is offered for Master’s and a few select Second-Entry Professional Undergraduate Degrees. This scholarship offers 130 scholarships and awards which includes 30 scholarships for successful applicants, and 100 awards for finalists not receiving the scholarship. McCall MacBain Scholarship is exclusively for McGill University, but you can apply to the university at the later date from the scholarship. It offers benefits such as tuition fee coverage, living stipend of $2,300 per month, one-time relocation grant, beginner to advanced french language courses, $5,000 summer grant for meaningful initiatives (upon approval), and opportunity to experience new culture. The deadline for McCall MacBain Scholarship is 20 August, 2025.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Your Nationality or citizenship must be of a country that is supported through the Rhodes scholarship.
Completed a school or college leaving exam (Intermediate, A-level or equivalent) at a school or college, OR have received an undergraduate degree at a university.
Candidates will have a higher chance of successful admission to Oxford if they have a First Class Honours Degree or equivalent, or GPA of 3.70/4.00 or higher.

All applicants must have English language proficiency at the higher level as required by the University of Oxford, which includes IELTS 7.5 overall with 7.0 in all components, or TOEFL iBT 110, or another equivalent test.

overview: The Rhodes Scholarship is a private and fully-funded postgraduate scholarship for talented young individuals to study full-time at the University of Oxford for two years. The scholarship is a merit-based scholarship that requires high academic excellence from applicants to be eligible. Benefits include tuition fee coverage, one round-trip airfare in economy-class, settlement allowance (once at arrival), annual stipend for living expenses and accommodation, application fee for university admission, as well as fee for student visa and International Health Surcharge (IHS) that covers health insurance in UK after arrival. The deadline for Rhodes Scholarship is 5 August, 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: A copy of a valid NADRA issued CNIC or passport issued by the Government of Pakistan.

Official transcripts from the college or university at which you are studying, or have studied, showing grades achieved (to date). All evidence must be formally certified by the Registrar, or other responsible officer, of the School, College or University.

requiredDocuments.details: A copy of Matriculation Result Sheet (or equivalent i.e. Ordinary Levels Statement of Result), Higher Secondary School Result Sheet (or equivalent i.e. Advanced Levels Statement of Result), Undergraduate Result Sheet, formally certified by the School, College or University.

A full CV which should include specific details about academic qualifications, prizes, scholarships, positions of leadership, employment positions, involvement in student, voluntary, community or political activities and any cultural, musical or sporting accomplishments. This should not exceed two A4 (12pt font size) pages in length.
A personal statement of no more than 1000 words.
An academic statement of no more than 350 words.

overview: Andrew Grant Postgraduate Scholarship is a partially-funded scholarship provided by the University of Edinburgh, UK. It is offered to students who wish to study Master’s degree (taught or research) in School of Art, School of Design, ESALA (Architecture and Landscape Architecture), History of Art, and Reid School of Music at the University. The scholarship provides many benefits, including £13,000 Fund, which is deducted automatically from the total tuition fee for 1 year. If the total amount is not used, the funds may go for living costs of the scholar. Other than that, training and development opportunities are also provided which are appropriate to the courses taken by the scholars. The students can also expect cultural exchange and vibrant postgraduate community to help them throughout their academics as well. The deadline for Andrew Grant Postgraduate Scholarships is in April, 2026 for the following September intake.

overview: Be the Difference Postgraduate International Scholarship is a university-funded partial scholarship for international students who are eager to bring change. University of Stirling in Scotland, UK, offers this scholarship to students who wish to study full-time Master’s taught programs as self-funded students. This scholarship is awarded in the form of a £7,000 tuition fee waiver for new students in the first year of a Master’s degree. It has 100 awards each year, distributed for September and following January intake. Enroll in any of the two intakes and receive discount in the total amount of your education. There is no fixed deadline for this scholarship, the applications are assessed on a rolling basis for the upcoming intake.

requiredDocuments.details: Submit a copy of valid passport information page that includes your details and photo on it.

An IELTS 6.0 band at least or another equivalent language proficiency test according to the course requirement.
Applicant also needs to send a brief personal statement that states their reasons for joining the chosen course and how they can use these studies to make a good career for themselves ahead.

Applicants need one reference letter from a professor or employer if they applying to one of the professional courses as mentioned: Advancing Practice, Applied Professional Studies, Health Psychology, Education, Physiotherapy (pre-registration), Podiatry (pre-registration), Psychology (accredited conversion), Social Work Studies, and Specialist Community Public Health Nurse (Health Visiting).

overview: Simmons Distinguished Scholar Award is a fully-funded scholarship by the Simmons University, USA. eligibilityCriteria.details: You must be studying for or currently hold the International Baccalaureate Diploma.

Applicant must receive an offer for a full-time or part-time undergraduate course at the University of Sheffield. MArch courses are considered Postgraduate and shouldn’t be applied with Undergraduate status.

overview: International Baccalaureate Merit Scholarship is a partially-funded scholarship for Undergraduate level students. It is sponsored by the University of Sheffield, UK. Only students who are currently studying or have studied an IB diploma are eligible to apply for the scholarship. This scholarship has many benefits including, £10,000 tuition fee waiver for each year of study which means that it can provide support for up to 4 years for Bachelor’s program. It is a prestigious and competitive award that also provides networking and career development opportunities. It is open for a wide range of programs, only excluding School of Dentistry and Medicine courses. The scholarship is only available for new international students who meet the eligibility criteria. The deadline for International Baccalaureate Merit Scholarship for Undergraduate is in May, 2026.

requiredDocuments.details: Scanned copies of your IB Diploma. Attach English translation (if required).
An IELTS 6.0 band at least or another equivalent language proficiency test according to the course requirement.

Applicant also needs to send a brief personal statement of 300 words that states their reasons for joining the chosen course and how they can use these studies to make a good career for themselves ahead.
Applicants may need one or two reference letters from a professor or employer if they are requested by department/course they have applied for.
A complete CV which includes employment, education, and other relevant extra-curricular activities that support the application. Especially beneficial for student with relevant work experience.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must receive an offer for a course at the University of Sheffield. MArch courses are considered Postgraduate and shouldn’t be applied with Undergraduate status.
For tuition fee purposes, the applicant must be self-funded and eligible to pay the overseas tuition fee. Sponsored students cannot apply.

overview: International Merit Scholarship is a partially-funded scholarship for Undergraduate and Graduate level students. It is sponsored by the University of Sheffield, UK. This scholarship has many benefits including, £10,000 tuition fee waiver for each year of study which means that it can provide support for up to 4 years for Bachelor’s and 2 years for Master’s. It is a prestigious and competitive award that also provides networking and career development opportunities. It is open for a wide range of programs, only excluding School of Dentistry and Medicine courses for Bachelor’s. The scholarship is only available for new international students who meet the eligibility criteria. The deadline for International Merit Scholarship for Undergraduate is in April, 2026 and in May, 2026 for Postgraduate Courses.

requiredDocuments.details: Scanned copies of your degree(s) and transcript(s) that you have acquired till date. Attach English translation of documents too (if required).
An IELTS 6.0 band at least or another equivalent language proficiency test according to the course requirement.

Applicant also needs to send a brief personal statement of 300 words that states their reasons for joining the chosen course and how they can use these studies to make a good career for themselves ahead.
Applicants may need one or two reference letters from a professor or employer if they are requested by department/course they have applied for.
A complete CV which includes employment, education, and other relevant extra-curricular activities that support the application. Especially beneficial for student with relevant work experience.
Where required, you can be asked to provide a portfolio of your creative work for assessment.

overview: The Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarships and Leadership Programme is an opportunity for outstanding Master’s level students to get a fully-funded scholarship to study at Oxford university, UK. It is funded by the Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Trust (60%) and University of Oxford (40%). The Leadership training is a unique addition, that allows the students to hone their overall skills through learning, practice, and demonstration. This scholarship includes many benefits for all scholars, they are, full tuition fee coverage, living expenses grant (of at least £19,000), leadership development guidance, long-term mentoring and networking, business skills learning and discussions, and communication training with a supportive community. By acquiring this scholarship, you can get international exposure that can help you advance in your future career. For Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarship, the application deadline falls between December and January each year. Each course may have different last date for submission.

requiredDocuments.details: Applicants will be provided with a scholarship statement template (by WWAH) that must be submitted along with the admission application. It includes personal, course, and work details along with a few assessment questions.
Scanned copies of your transcript(s) that you have acquired till date. Attach English translation of documents too (if required).
A scanned copy of IELTS or another equivalent language proficiency test according to the course requirement.

Applicant also needs to send a personal statement according to the word limit advised (different for each course). WWAH will guide you about the requirements of each course’s personal statement/statement of purpose and how to make a lasting impression.

Applicants will also need to submit referee details of 3 academics or professionals. For most departments, two of the references must be academic or more. However, check details once before applied to your chosen course.

Applicant are required to send one or two essays related to their field of study for assessment along with the application. It may or may not be an excerpt from a thesis; check with WWAH to get proper guidance on the requirements for your chosen course.
An updated CV that showcases your educational background, work experience, and other achievements (preferably in the chosen field).
For a select few courses, you may need to attach your GRE General Test results for assessment.
If required, you may need to send a brief research proposal for your research while studying in the Oxford.

benefits: Research, Training and Supporting Grant of £5,000 (paid once)
Cost of Immigration to the UK (if required)

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must apply for a PhD at the University of Warwick to begin in October for being eligible to apply for the scholarship.
Applicant must be assessed as 'overseas' for fees purposes.

overview: Chancellor’s International Scholarships by the University of Warwick are fully-funded scholarships for PhD students. It is only given to the outstanding students with excellent research skills and potential of achieving great results. This scholarship offers many benefits including full payment of tuition fee, a good maintenance stipend for 3.5 years, grant for research, training and support of £5,000 (which is provided once), cost of immigration to the UK (if required for the scholar), as well as a chance to research any discipline, even taking interdisciplinary approach and enhancing networking skills. The deadline for Chancellor’s International Scholarship at the University of Warwick is in December, 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: Scanned copies of your degree(s) and transcript(s) that you have acquired till date. Attach English translation of documents too (if required).
A scanned copy of IELTS or another equivalent language proficiency test according to the course requirement.

Applicant also needs to send a brief personal statement of 1-2 pages that states their reasons for joining the chosen course and how they can use these studies to make a good career for themselves ahead.

Applicants will also need to submit two academic reference letters from their professors, supervisors, or other academics who can attest their skills. The referees will be sent link to upload their references themselves.

A research proposal containing title, research aims and questions, methodology, scope of the project, and an indicative bibliography. However, the specific requirements for each course might differ along with the required word count.

A complete and up-to-date CV which includes employment, education, and other relevant extra-curricular activities that support the application. Especially beneficial for students with relevant work experience.

overview: Dean’s Award for Academic Excellence Scholarship is a partially-funded scholarship offered by the University of Bath, UK. It is open to applicants of all nationalities and is awarded on the basis of academic excellence. The scholarship is distributed equally among the Faculties of Engineering & Design, Humanities & Social Sciences, and Science.This competitive and selective scholarship offers tuition fee waiver of £5,000 at the start of the course, access to faculty members with excellent credibility, as well as countless networking opportunities with the right people. It serves as a reward for students with strong academic credentials who can prove their achievement and success in previous academic years. The deadline for Dean’s Award for Academic Excellence Scholarship is in June, 2026.

requiredDocuments.details: Scanned copies of your degree(s) and transcript(s) that you have acquired till date. Attach English translation of documents too (if required).
An IELTS 6.5 band at least or another equivalent language proficiency test according to the course requirement.

Applicant also needs to send a brief personal statement of 400-600 words that states their reasons for joining the chosen course and how they can use these studies to make a good career for themselves ahead.
Applicants should also submit one reference letter from a professor or employer who can attest their skills.

A complete and up-to-date CV which includes employment, education, and other relevant extra-curricular activities that support the application. Especially beneficial for student with relevant work experience.

overview: Exeter Excellence Scholarships are partially-funded scholarships for Undergraduate and Postgraduate students as an award for their outstanding academic achievements and commitment to bring forth real change in the world. It is funded by the University of Exeter, UK for international students from all over the world. The scholarship is awarded as a reduction in the International tuition fee for each eligible year of study for Undergraduate whereas for Postgraduate, the scholarship is awarded as a reduction in the first-year tuition fees only. As for the benefits, the scholarship offers the awards of £3,000 or £5,000 to Undergraduate applicants and awards of £3,000, £5,000 or £10,000 for Postgraduate applicants. It also helps students in enhancing their global engagement and provides them networking and career opportunities. The Exeter Excellence Scholarships have 2 rounds of application submission for Undergraduate scholarships and 3 rounds of Postgraduate scholarships. Round 1 Deadline: In February; Round 2 Deadline: In April; and Round 3 (for Postgraduate January Intake only) Deadline: In October. Currently, the 3rd round for Postgraduate January Intake is ongoing and has the deadline of 31 October, 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: Scanned copies of your transcript(s) that you have acquired till date. Attach English translation of documents too (if required).
A scanned copy of IELTS or another equivalent language proficiency test according to the course requirement.

Applicant also needs to send two brief personal statement up to 500 words (for admission) and 300 words (for scholarship). Each should be tailored according to the provided requirements and must state your reasons for joining the chosen course and how these studies will help in making a good career.

Applicants will also need to submit one reference letter (and two only if your course/department requires another) from their professors, supervisors, or even employers who can attest their skills. Either you can acquire references from your referees and send them or ask them to send their references themselves.

Only applicants with Overseas Status are allowed to apply for the scholarship.

For an undergraduate programme, the high school grades should be equivalent to 128 UCAS points or above. For a postgraduate taught programme, you need an undergraduate degree equivalent to a 2:1 or higher.

For undergraduate level, intermediate degree holders will need to complete a Foundation Year before being accepted into the Bachelor’s. Or, the applicant should take a University course with Foundation Year.

overview: Global Leaders Scholarship is a partially-funded scholarship for international applicants who can demonstrate the highest levels of academic, personal, and extracurricular endeavor. It is offered by the University of Lincoln, UK for the undergraduate and postgraduate (taught) courses. This scholarship has many benefits. It waives 50% of tuition fees for one year of study for all selected applicants. It also provides numerous exclusive networking events where scholars can meet and interact with professionals and alumni, alike. Scholars will also be awarded their scholarships in a ceremony. Other than that, all scholarship holders will be invited to apply for the International Student Ambassador position at the University of Lincoln. The scholarship is awarded on a rolling basis and scholars can apply for any of the 5 Rounds (3 Rounds for September Intake: in January, March, and June; and 2 Rounds for January Intake: in October and November) in an academic year. Currently, the upcoming deadlines for January 2026 intake are Round 1: 3 October, 2025, and Round 2: 7 November 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: All applicants must submit their previous academic transcript with the application. If the degree is yet to finish, submit the up-to-date transcript with your application.
An IELTS 6.5 band at least or another equivalent language proficiency test according to the course requirement.
Applicant also needs to send a brief personal statement that states their reasons for joining the chosen course and how they can use these studies to make a good career for themselves ahead.
Applicants should also submit one reference letter from a professor or employer who can attest their skills.

A complete and up-to-date CV which includes employment, education, and other relevant extra-curricular activities that support the application. Especially beneficial for student with relevant work experience.

Thesis Allowance up to 20,000 Baht (subject to approval) along with Printing Cost
Return Economy Class Air Ticket and Airport Pick-Up Service

eligibilityCriteria.details: Candidates must be nominated by the National Focal Point for International Development Cooperation in a country from the TIPP eligible countries/territories list.
Candidates must be no more than 45 years of age.
Candidates must have Bachelor’s degree and/or professional experience related field or related to graduate degree.
Preference will be given to candidates who are working in the government sector or in a related field to their selected course.

Candidates must have a good command of English. Candidates whose first language is not English and Bachelor’s degree was not instructed in English, have to pass an English Language proficiency test according to criteria required by the academic institution regulations.
Other requirements apart from these will be under consideration by the University regulations. TICA reserves the rights to revoke scholarship offered to awardees who violate rules and regulations.

overview: Thailand International Postgraduate Programme (TIPP) is a fully-funded government scholarship for Master’s degree. Each year, Thailand government agency, TICA, announces scholarships for a few select courses in specified universities according to the Sustainable Development Themes in focus. These themes include Sufficiency Economy Philosophy (SEP), Public Health, Climate Change and Environmental Issues, Agriculture and Food Security, Bio-Circular-Green Economy Model and Others (SDGs). TIPP Scholarship offers many benefits including tuition fee reimbursement, allowance for living, settlement (once), accommodation, books, and thesis, visa assistance, return air tickets, airport pick-up service, and insurance coverage. For this scholarship, you need to submit all documents in 1 original and 2 copy sets to be eligible for consideration. The deadline for TIPP scholarship is 31 January, 2026.

requiredDocuments.details: The official application form with complete details and signature.

Medical report on the official form (provided) that is signed and stamped by a physician. If candidate submits other health certificates without the TICA medical report form, their application will not be accepted for consideration.
A complete transcript that lists the courses you have learnt throughout your Bachelor’s degree.
The degree certificate of your completed Bachelor’s degree.
Recommendation letters from at least 3 person (1 person per letter) e.g. university instructor, supervisor in the candidate’s organization, employer etc.

English Language proficiency test (e.g. TOEFL, IELTS) as required by the academic institution, which is within the 2 years of the date of admission. Not required for students who have studied previous degree in English.
University may ask for other documents (according to the chosen courses).

benefits: Fully Funded Scholarship for One Year

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must have finished or will finish their undergraduate degree by 1st August, prior to applications' deadline.
Applicant must be in between 18 to 28 years (by 1st August of enrollment year; 2026)
Applicant must showcase extraordinary leadership skills, along with other soft skills necessary for success. Applicant must be able to convince interview panel (if they are selected).

overview: Schwarzman Scholars is an excellent scholarship for young adults having leadership skills. This scholarship is a fully funded scholarship for one-year Master’s degree in Global Affairs at the Tsinghua University in Beijing. The main goal of this scholarship is to gather a community of future leaders who will be playing a big role in the geopolitical landscape of the future. The classes usually start in August for each cycle. Schwarzman Scholars supports all expenses related to the scholarship, even the interview expenses such as economy class air or train travel, group meals, and one night in a hotel if needed, are arranged and covered by the program. Other benefits that Schwarzman Scholars covers include: tuition fees, room and board, travel to and from Beijing at the beginning and end of the academic year, in-country study tours, required course books and supplies, a Lenovo laptop, health insurance, and a personal stipend. You can also learn Chinese and/or English, pursue internships, and receive personalized mentorship from their selected mentor.

requiredDocuments.details: You need to have a valid passport before sending application to send relevant information and even use it at the time of interview or selection.
Applicant must have an updated Resume that explains and details your leadership experiences.

requiredDocuments.document: 2 Essays (Leadership Essay and Statement of Purpose)
requiredDocuments.details: The required essays are a Leadership Essay (750 words) and a Statement of Purpose (500 words). The essays are a critical component of the application, designed to help the selection committee understand you as an individual and get a sense of your leadership abilities/potential, as well as your writing and analytical skills.
Applicant must scan and upload official transcripts for each post-secondary education degree earned.
Applicants must arrange 3 Recommendation Letters from their professors, supervisors, faculty members, mentors, employers, or other appropriate recommenders.
A one-minute video introduction of yourself, in your own style and manner. However, it is optional.

If you are a native English speaker or have studied in English in a previous degree for at least 2 years, you do not need to submit a test. Otherwise, IELTS band should be 7.0 or another equivalent test.

overview: Silk Road Scholarship is also known as ‘Belt and Road’ Scholarship and it is also funded by the Chinese Scholarships Council (CSC). This is a fully-funded scholarship for students from 60+ countries which are included in the ‘Belt and Road Initiative.’ It includes bachelor’s, master’s, and doctorate degrees in various competitive fields that provide great opportunities for students to acquire knowledge and build their future careers. You may apply to English or Chinese-based courses in any of the universities listed ahead. Each year, you can expect some changes in the courses and can apply accordingly. Usually, all competitive fields are given priority and multiple seats are opened for each field. Before applying, make sure you have complete documents and meet the eligibility criteria of the scholarship to move forward.

Applicants should write their applications on their own as well as the personal statements. AI-based applications are usually rejected.

overview: Stuart Hall scholarship is a partially-funded scholarship that offers £5,000 tuition fee reduction in the total tuition fee. International students can apply for this scholarship if they are looking to start Master’s degree at the University of Sussex at one of the eligible courses listed ahead. You need to apply for the course first before applying for the scholarship. The deadline is 1 July, 2025. You must have at least 3.5 or above CGPA or 75% or above marks in the previous degree to move forward with the application. The eligible courses are offered in full-time and part-time study models, but only full-time courses are accepted for the scholarship.

requiredDocuments.document: Valid Passport and National ID Card
requiredDocuments.details: A copy of your valid passport and national ID Card, as proof of identity.

requiredDocuments.document: Academic Transcripts and Certificates of 10th & 12th Class and Bachelor’s Degree
requiredDocuments.details: Along with the Passport and other documents, you need to submit your academic Transcripts and certificates.

requiredDocuments.document: English Language Proficiency Test Scores-IELTS, TOEFL, PTE & Others
requiredDocuments.details: If English is not your first language, you may need to provide scores from English proficiency tests like IELTS, TOEFL, or PTE.

One of the key documents needed for a university application is a recommendation letter. You need one letter from a teacher, professor, or employer who can attest to your academic abilities and character. The letter must be on a organizational headed paper, which is dated, signed, or even stamped with institutes name.

It is also an important document for university application. A Statement of Purpose explains your motivations for applying, your academic and career goals, and why you are interested in the course and university.
For creative courses such as art, design, and architecture, you may need to submit a portfolio showcasing your work.
