overview: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship is a fully-funded scholarship that sponsors PhD candidates in their pursuit of higher education. In this scholarship, there are a number of specified universities and research institutes that can collaborate with research students to help them complete their doctorate projects. It is intended for highly qualified researchers who have never been to Switzerland before. The applicants must find and secure support from a supervisor in Switzerland (who works in a relevant field in a university or research institute) before applying, as it is the most important and critical need of a successful scholarship award. Applicants need to submit 2 sets of required documents with 1st set containing the original, signed documents plus the confidential letters of recommendation and, if applicable the attested translations in English. For 2nd set, it should include copies of all enclosed documents except the recommendation letters. This scholarship offers monthly grant payments, housing allowance (one-off), health insurance, half-fare on public transport, trips, dinners, tours, and return flight (for selective students). PhD students will also be allowed to conduct fieldwork, if needed, for the project up to 6 months.

requiredDocuments.details: Signed ESKAS application form (typed and printed) with photo.

A full CV with list of personal education and training, degrees and diplomas (with precise dates), awards, academic positions (with precise dates), non-academic positions (with precise dates), publications with references, conferences, academic teaching experiences, extra academic teaching experiences, links to your science blogs, your presentations online etc.
A motivation letter (max. 2 pages) that states your reasons for applying to the course and scholarship. It is a very important document for securing an admission.

All applicants must have a clear research goal. Candidates have to submit a complete research proposal (max. 5 pages, signed) including a layman abstract in English, using exclusively the ESKAS research proposal form (provided). It is a central part of your application that requires attention.

A copy of the support letter from an academic host professor (including her/his short CV, maximum 2 pages) at the chosen Swiss university confirming why she/he is willing to support and supervise the research.

For PhD scholarships at doctoral schools (aka doctoral programmes) only: The confirmation for accepted admission is required. A support letter from a host professor is required in any case additionally.

Two confidential letters of recommendation from two different professors in the applicant’s field, and not identical with the academic supervisor at the host institution in Switzerland (use exclusively the ESKAS form – originals in sealed envelopes only, for the first set). No copies for 2nd set.

Photocopies of certificates and grade sheets from previously attended universities/ colleges and diplomas with grades, starting with the most recent. If not in English, French, Italian or German; send with attested certified translations in English. Do not submit the original certificates.
Signed medical certificate named “Fit for mission” (please only use the provided ESKAS form).

eligibilityCriteria.details: Above-average grades (upper-third) in Social and Political Sciences, Law, Economics, Public Policy and Administration. Not older than six years old.

overview: The Helmut-Schmidt-Programme (DAAD) is a fully-funded scholarship sponsored by German Federal Foreign Office. It is a scholarship that contributes in developing future leaders in the fields of social, political, and economics who can learn public policies and good governance. The given courses are for September/October intake 2026. The applicants must have studied and work previously in a relevant field to be eligible. All courses are provided in English language. Other than the listed benefits, scholarship holders will also get rent subsidy, family supplements (if and as applicable) as well as the chance to attend networking events and seminars to socialize and connect with others.

requiredDocuments.details: Fill out the checklist form and sign it by hand before signing it and accompanying it with the application.
Fill the application form to submit it for the scholarship.

One motivation letter (max. 2 pages long) that includes date of issue, precise personal, academic, and professional reasons for applying to the scholarship as well as detailed explanation for choosing one or more courses from Helmut-Schmidt Scholarship. It should clearly state choice 1 and choice 2 if you are applying to two courses. Same letter will be sent to both chosen universities.
A C.V in a reverse chronological order (format: europass) with the date of issue. Any gaps of more than three months must be explained.
Copies of all degree certificates that you have achieved until now. Must be in English or German, or attach certified translations with other language degrees.
Copy of full set of transcripts with an explanation of the grading system. Provide certified translations if transcripts are not in German or English.

Confirmation of relevant work experience (can be internship, community/political service, volunteer work etc.) on a headed paper, including an original (not scanned) or code certified digital signature, the date of issue and a stamp.
English language proficiency test result according to the course requirement.

Recent written reference letter from current employer (or professor, if studying presently) on headed paper, including an original (not scanned) or code certified digital signature, the date of issue and a stamp. If necessary, please provide a certified translation.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant's from all countries can apply except Russia.
Applicant must have 3.5 CGPA out of 4.0 to be eligible. Percentage equivalent 87.5%.

Applicant must have an English Proficiency Test (IELTS, TOEFL, CEFR, or other) Result that is acquired within 3 years of application. For Arts, IELTS 6.5, TOEFL 90, or CEFR B2 level is must; for other courses, IELTS 7.0, TOEFL 94, or CEFR C1 level is must.

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Applied for Any Listed University Course
eligibilityCriteria.details: The applicant applies to take up a master's degree programme at a Flemish higher education institution. This master's degree consists of 60 ECTS per academic year.

The applicant can only be nominated for scholarship by one Flemish higher education institution. If the applicant is pre-selected by more than one Flemish higher education institution, he/she has to choose one.

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Previous Degree Must Not be from a Flemish Institute
eligibilityCriteria.details: The previous degree obtained, for which the student has been approved for the master programme, should not have been obtained at a Flemish higher education institution. International students who have been on credit mobility in a hosting Flemish higher education institution are still eligible for a Master Mind Scholarship.
Students who are already enrolled in a Flemish higher education institution cannot apply.

overview: The Flemish Ministry of Education and Training awards fully-funded scholarships for master's programmes in Flanders and Brussels to outstanding students from around the world. A Master Mind Scholarship includes a grant of €10,020 + a tuition fee waiver per academic year (60 ECTS). Master Mind Scholarship holders only pay an administrative enrolment fee. The grant is paid in installments and covers accommodation costs, insurances and a significant amount of their living expenses. You need to apply to one of the Flemish host institutions that participates in the Master Mind Scholarship Programme to get this scholarship.

If shortlisted, you'll be invited for a written test in subjects like Mathematics, English, and Japanese (optional). It will be a subject-based test conducted by the Embassy of Japan in your country, after your initial application is accepted. The test assesses your academic potential in key areas relevant to your chosen field of study.
If your field of study is Humanities, the tested subjects will be Mathematics, English, Japanese (optional). If you choose Natural sciences as your field of study, the tested subjects will be Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, English, Japanese (optional). Each subject paper is usually 30–60 minutes. 
An interview, which may cover your academic interests, future plans, and adaptability to studying in Japan. This will be conducted by a panel of embassy officials, education experts, or former scholars and it usually held at the Japanese Embassy or virtually (online). The interview duration will be 15-30 minutes.
WWAH will notify you about dates and help you prepare with sample questions and tips.

duration.masters: Bachelor's Program: 5 years to 7 years (including 1 year preparatory course)

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicants must have the nationality of a country that has diplomatic relations with Japan.
Applicant must be born on or after April 2, 2001 (exceptions for applicants with serious circumstances like military service, conditions of war etc)
Applicant must be willing to learn Japanese language or have already learned it.
Applicant must provide proof of health that they are clear to travel and study.
Applicants must newly obtain and enter Japan with a “Student” visa, regardless of any prior residency status, or risk suspension of the MEXT scholarship.

overview: The MEXT Undergraduate Scholarship is reserved for individuals who are looking to enroll in any Bachelor's program specified in the program. The MEXT scholarships have 2 screenings in which you must pass to get a chance to study there. You can apply at Japanese embassy to know the rules and regulations of your particular programs and dates to apply/submit documents within. This scholarship goes on from 5 to 7 years. In these durations, 1 year is for preparatory course that can be waived if you have Japanese language proficiency. The majors you can select are provided in specified categories where you can choose up to three options. The main categories include: 1. Social Sciences and Humanities, 2. Natural Sciences.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must be a citizen of a developing country.
Applicant must be in good health.
Applicant must have a good academic record.
Applicant must have a strong interest in studying in China.
Applicant must also meet the language requirements of the chosen program.

overview: The MOFCOM Scholarship, established by the Ministry of Commerce of the People’s Republic of China, provides financial support to international students pursuing master’s and PhD degrees in China. It provides full and partial scholarships to the students who wish to study in China. Full scholarships include tuition fee waiver, accommodation allowance or housing, living allowance, and comprehensive medical insurance; and partial scholarships include tuition fee waiver only. Shortlisted candidates are called for interview (in-person or online) after applications are assessed. All requirements, including language requirements, must be met for each course.

requiredDocuments.details: You need to submit the filled application form for MOFCOM Scholarship.
Applicant will need to submit the notarized copy of the highest degree acquired.
Applicant must also submit their full transcripts of the highest degree achieved (notarized copy).
One recommendation letter from academic perspective and one from a current employer.
One photocopy of your passport.
Given physical examination form filled and signed by a medical professional.
A photocopy of your passed English proficiency test.

requiredDocuments.document: No Criminal Certificate Record (Police Clearance Certificate)
requiredDocuments.details: A police clearance certificate that states that you don't have any criminal history.
A study plan or research proposal that outlines the research you wish to undertake ahead.
You may need to submit a Chinese Language Proficiency test result, accepted score may vary for various universities and courses.

requiredDocuments.document: Recent visa or residence permit in China (if applicable)
requiredDocuments.details: Visa or residence permit of China that allows you to study there.
Economic or financial proof of your earnings in recent years.
An acceptance letter from the university you applied for.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must not be more than 45 years old at the time of application.
A minimum of Second Class Upper (Honours) or a minimum CGPA of 3.0 or equivalent at the Undergraduate level.
Excellent level of health certified by a doctor/ physician. Medical report form will be provided. The Medical Report must be valid within 6 months from the date of application.
Applicant must have 1 admission offer letter or a conditional offer letter from a university when applying for a scholarship.

overview: The Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme (MTCP) Scholarship is a fully funded government scholarship that is supported in 20+ universities of Malaysia. It is a scholarship for international students who wish to pursue Master’s degree. MTCP Scholarship offers full tuition fee coverage (paid directly to the university upon issuance of invoice by the university), monthly allowance of RM3,500; paid directly to applicants’ Malaysian bank account, one-off return economy class airline ticket from the student's closest international airport to Malaysia and back to the student's home country. It also offers an opportunity for students to get international exposure, experience new culture, and get mentorship and guidance from learned faculty of the listed universities. The deadline for the Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme (MTCP) is in June, 2026 (however, it is recommended to get university admission letter within May for a smooth process of scholarship).

requiredDocuments.details: A copy of the passport information page as evidence of nationality (minimum of 12 months validity).

Record of all the courses taken throughout the degree programme must be reflected in the academic transcripts. Applicants must submit an official document describing the university’s grade system. If it is not included, then the documents must be certified.
TOEFL/IELTS/ PTE/ CAE/ CPE/ MUET/ equivalent qualification or an official letter from the previous institution declaring English as the medium of instruction used for the obtained degree(s).
A Curriculum Vitae (CV) that includes all details about applicant’s education, work experience, and other relevant activities etc.
Medical examination report (on the provided form) by a practicing doctor or physician.
Letter of recommendations from two (2) referees (on the provided form).

eligibilityCriteria.details: At the time of application, candidates must be in the first or second year of a doctoral program.

At the time of application, candidates must be a Canadian student in a Canadian university, a Canadian student in an international university, or an international student studying in a Canadian university. Students from international universities that are living outside Canada are not eligible.

Candidates’ research must clearly align with one or more of the Foundation’s four themes, namely, 1. Human Rights and Dignity, 2. Responsible Citizenship, 3. Canada and the World, 4. People and their Natural Environment.

An eligible doctoral program must be research oriented (PhD, JD, etc.) and must lead to a thesis, dissertation, scholarly publication, etc. Professional doctorates are not eligible. Joint programs with a professional degree (JD/PhD; MBA/PhD, etc.) may be eligible if they have a significant research component.

overview: Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation Scholarship is one of the prestigious private scholarships in Canada that funds ongoing PhD’s in Canadian institutions. The foundation works and funds the four main themes it abides by, namely, 1. Human Rights and Dignity, 2. Responsible Citizenship, 3. Canada and the World, 4. People and their Natural Environment. You may take admission in any university of Canada to be eligible for the scholarship. The scholarship offers many benefits including scholarship payment of $50,000 per year for tuition and living expenses with additional $20,000 per year for doing research, networking and travel expenses to complete your project. It also offers other perks such as membership in a vibrant alumni community of 500+ individuals, permission to work part-time with the studies, networking opportunity with mentors and fellows, as well as providing support and encouragement to improve English and French while studying. The deadline to apply for Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation Scholarship is November 17, 2025, at 4:00 p.m. ET.

overview: The Queen Elizabeth Commonwealth Scholarships (QECS) are fully funded scholarships provided for achieving Master’s degree. These scholarships are awarded for two years in a low or middle-income Commonwealth country. It is for students who are committed to creating change in their communities through cultural exchange and academic collaboration. Each year there are two opportunities to apply for QECS; Cycle 1 opens in November/December and Cycle 2 opens in March/April. Right now, cycle 2 is accepting applications until 4th June, 2025. You only need to submit one application, but you are welcome to apply more than once if there is another country you are interested in studying in.

Applicants may be asked to submit one or more reference letters to the university.
Must have a IELTS, TOEFL, or an equivalent test result with minimum score required for admission (if required by course/university).

A personal statement explains your interests, achievements, and reasons for choosing the course.Three Personal Statements named as: Plan of Study, Development Impact and Post-Study Outreach, Creating Networks should be submitted.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Proof of citizenship or refugee status in one of the listed Commonwealth countries.
Applicant must be residing permanently in a developing Commonwealth country.
A degree of at least upper second class (2:1) standard. A lower qualification and sufficient relevant experience may be considered in certain cases.
Applicant must acknowledge that they can't study without this scholarship.
Applicant must attach two reference letters (from legitimate sources) with application to be considered eligible.
Applicant must apply and secure an offer letter from any eligible universities to receive the scholarship.

overview: Commonwealth Distance Learning Scholarships are for students from eligible low and middle income Commonwealth countries who cannot afford to travel or study in the UK on their own. They can study part-time taught Master’s degree with UK universities while remaining in their home countries through this programme. It is a fully funded, government scholarship that covers complete tuition fee and research grants (where needed) for students, who, otherwise would not be able to afford studying in the UK. The courses can range from 1 to 5 years, with reduced hours that allows applicants to focus on studies as well as job or other responsibilities.

requiredDocuments.details: Upload a copy of passport or ID card that clearly shows photograph, date of birth, and country of citizenship.
Full and up-to-date academic transcripts that list all courses currently studying or previously studied in each degree earned. Incomplete or missing record will result in disqualification.
Certificates of degrees you have earned until the date of application.
Two reference letters in PDF format. They should be signed and on institutional letterhead or an email that clearly shows the sender's details.
You will need to submit a 500-word personal statement which mentions your experiences and why you are best suited for the scholarship.
You will be required to answer a few questions on how you will be making an impact on the world, your country, and on a local level by studying the chosen course.
You will also need to share how you will obtain your career objectives while studying and after completing the course.

overview: China Scholarship Council (CSC), entrusted by the Ministry of Education, People's Republic of China, is responsible for the Chinese Government Scholarship Program. Qualified applicants can apply for scholarship for Undergraduate/Bachelors, Masters & Doctoral/PhD programs in respective field of studies. The Bilateral Scholarship Program is conducted in partnership with various countries and their regulatory authorities to select and forward candidates to the Chinese embassies after preliminary selection. For Pakistan, HEC verifies the candidates. You need to have obtained a valid USAT (for undergraduate studies) or HAT (for postgraduate studies) score for applying to this scholarship. After selection, you can expect full or partial scholarship in your selected course(s).

overview: The CSC Scholarship-University Program is a full and partial-funded scholarship program that allows the students to acquire scholarships for Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD degrees in China. It offers tuition fee waiver for partial scholarship and tuition fee waiver, accommodation allowance, comprehensive medical insurance, monthly stipend, and research opportunities for the fully-funded scholarship. These scholarships are offered at selected universities that are authorized by the CSC. The courses can be in Chinese or English, where you will be expected to show language proficiency through test (HSK for Chinese; IELTS, TOEFL for English). Each university, course may have additional expectations than the one mentioned here. You are advised to research each course you are interested in applying.

requiredDocuments.details: You need to submit the filled application form for CSC Scholarship.
Applicant will need to submit the notarized copy of the highest degree acquired.
Applicant must also submit their full transcripts of he highest degree achieved (notarized copy).
One recommendation letter from academic perspective and one from a current employer.
One photocopy of your passport.
Given physical examination form filled and signed by a medical professional.
A photocopy of your passed English or Chinese proficiency test (according to the course requirement).
A police clearance certificate that states that you don't have any criminal history.
A study plan or research proposal that outlines the research you wish to undertake ahead.

overview: The Youth of Excellence Scheme (YES) Scholarship is a fully funded scholarship that is Government-funded for international students. It offers one and two year (1+1) Master’s programs. For one (or first) year, all expenses are paid by the scholarship which includes full tuition fee, on-campus accommodation, comprehensive medical insurance, air ticket at the start (for entering China) and at the end (for leaving China), one-off settlement subsidy, living allowance, and for two year program, the candidates are sent back to their home countries and given air ticket to come back for their dissertation defense only. You need to have a Bachelor’s degree, English language proficiency, and at least 3 years of work experience for applying to this scholarship. All courses in this scholarship scheme are English-taught.

overview: DAAD offers many government funded scholarships to students looking for studying in Germany. Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS) is a scholarship for Master’s and PhD level students who wish to continue higher studies in a development-related field. This is a fully funded scholarship that covers tuition fee, health, accident, and private liability insurance, travel allowance, as well as monthly assistance with rent and supplements (upon request only). For eligibility, each candidate must have previous degree (bachelor’s for graduate and master’s for doctorate), two years of work experience, language proficiency (English or German; whichever specified), and proven motivation to work in a development-related field.

Economic, Social, Political, Environmental Development Themes

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Domicile of A Developing Commonwealth Country
eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must be domiciled in Africa, South Asia or one of the Commonwealth countries.
Applicant must be classified as an overseas student for fee purposes.
Any current student or graduate of the University of Nottingham, or someone already studying in UK is not allowed to hold this scholarship.

overview: Developing Solutions Master’s Scholarship is a university-funded scholarship that was founded in 2001. It is sponsored by the University of Nottingham for students from selected Commonwealth countries for Master’s taught program. This scholarship is designed for international students who want to make a difference to the development of key economic, environmental, structural, social, or political structures in their home country. You can apply in any full-time masters (including MRes) in the Faculty of Engineering, Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences, Faculty of Science or Faculty of Social Sciences. The University of Nottingham is offering scholarships covering 50% or 100% of full-time masters tuition fees. The scholarship is primarily for one year but can be used for two years’ Master’s as well.  The scholarship supports innovative students who can demonstrate their ingenuity for developing solutions that will impact their home countries and incite change. The deadline for Developing Solutions Master’s Scholarship is April, 2026.

requiredDocuments.details: Scanned copies of your degree(s) and transcript(s) that you have acquired till date.
An IELTS 6.0 band at least or another equivalent language proficiency test according to the course requirement.
Applicant also needs to send a personal statement that states their reasons for joining the course/university and how they can use these studies to make a good career for themselves ahead.

At least 2 reference letters will be required for admission in the University of Nottingham. The referees will be contacted by the university when you will provide their details. They must upload their references within the provided deadline.
The applicants who possess relevant work experience (if any), can also attach an experience letter with a signed letterhead.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant with any nationality can apply except Korea. Parents or legal guardian must not have Korean citizenship either.

Applicant must have previous degree required for admission, e.g. Intermediate, Bachelor’s and Master’s for Bachelor’s, Master’s and PhD degrees respectively. For Associate degrees, you require high school degree. For applicants WITH associate degree, they may apply for a Bachelor's.
Score percentile should be 80% or above on a 100-point scale or be ranked in the top 20% of one’s class. CGPA must be equal to or above 2.64/4.0, 2.80/4.3, 2.91/4.5 or 3.23/5.0.
Applicants must be in good mental and physical health to study in Korea.

overview: Global Korea Scholarship (GSK) is a fully-funded government scholarship that is offered for Associate, Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD degrees in South Korea. Applicants can choose from 2 application tracks: 1. Embassy Track or 2. University Track. In Embassy track, applicants can submit application in 3 universities at the same time but in University track, you only apply to one. The benefits of the scholarship include 5 Million KRW for tuition fee; if there is any extra cost for undergraduate programs, it will be covered by the university. Admission fee is paid by the University as well. It also includes economy-class air ticket (actual expense), monthly allowance (for Undergraduate degrees: 13,600,000 KRW per year and for Graduate degrees: 15,720,000 KRW per year). The scholarship also covers Korean Language training fee of 5.2 Million KRW (given in four quarters). The deadline for Global Korea Scholarship for Undergraduate Program is October, 2025, and deadline for the Graduate Program is February, 2026.

benefits: A Minimum of 50% Tuition Fee Waiver

eligibilityCriteria.details: The applicant must be admitted as an international applicant to one of the eligible universities.
Applicant must also demonstrate interest and personal initiative in activities involving intercultural learning and exchange.

overview: The #YouAreWelcomeHere Scholarship is a privately-funded partial scholarship for students who wish to study in the USA. It is offered to first-year students who enroll in a Bachelor’s or Associate degree in any one of the eligible universities. It recognizes the international students who wish to enhance their intercultural understanding. All participating institutions will award two scholarships in this program. The benefits of this scholarship includes a minimum of 50% tuition fee waiver, annually renewable scholarships (if conditions are met), along with many networking and career advancement opportunities. The application deadline varies for each university.

requiredDocuments.details: Original transcript(s) of your completed high school degree. Attach English translation of documents too (if required).
Applicants need to submit referee details of academics. The universities may request one or two references from your school counselors or teachers.
Submit official test scores of an English Language Proficiency test (IELTS, TOEFL, etc.) according to the minimum requirement of each course.
SAT or ACT scores can be submitted to the university. They are required for some universities and are optional for others. Check once before applying.
An updated CV that showcases your educational background, work experience, and other achievements (preferably in the chosen field) for students who have gap(s) in their academic journey.
It should describe your skills, experience and academic achievements and interest in studying your chosen subject/course and the university. It should highlight your motivation behind application.
Some universities require a short essay or video where a student explains their leadership skills and motivation for studying in the U.S. university.
Applicants may be required to submit other additional documents according to the specific course/university they apply for.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must have achieved a 1st class honours Undergraduate degree. Applicant’s who have yet to receive final result may include an evidence of the predicted equivalent grades.

Applicant must be a self-funded student on a full-time, on campus postgraduate course to be eligible. The applicants should be categorized as Overseas or International student at the university for fee purposes.

overview: The Faculty of Science and Health Global Postgraduate Taught Scholarship is a university-funded partial scholarship that is provided to students taking admission in one of the Faculty’s eligible Master’s taught courses at the University of Portsmouth, UK. The scholarship is offered in both September and January intakes and is provided to students with 1st class honours Undergraduate degree or equivalent qualification. As for the benefits, the scholarship gives a £2,000 fee reduction (provided at the time of registration) for the first year. It can only be combined with one other scholarship at the University of Portsmouth, the VC Global Development Scholarship, which is provided if the International student is from one of the approved list of nationalities. The current deadline for the Faculty of Science and Health Postgraduate Taught Scholarship, January Intake is 31 October, 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: A Personal Statement or Statement of Purpose explaining why you want to study the chosen course at the University of Portsmouth.
Officially certified copies of your degree qualification and grades. Attach English translations, if required.
Proof of your English language proficiency, such as IELTS test result or another equivalent test accepted by the University.
Two references are required for postgraduate courses. Make sure to engage two academics who can send a recommendation letter to the University on your behalf.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must receive an offer letter to study a full time Bachelor’s degree at Sussex University in 2026.
Applicant must be a self-financing student who can pay the rest of the expenses.

Applicant must have excellent academic grades. Bachelor’s degree with an overall result at 90% in Division I for Bachelor’s degree. Bachelor’s degree with a minimum overall grade of 80% or Master’s with 70% for Master’s degree.

overview: Chancellor’s International Scholarships are available to 'excellent' undergraduate and graduate international applicants. These partially funded scholarship is sponsored by the University of Sussex. These scholarships are highly competitive and only applicants with exceptional academic record will be considered. You must be accepted into the university to apply for the scholarship. The Chancellor’s International Scholarship mainly offers £5,000 tuition fee reduction in the first year of studies. However, it has many other benefits including, opportunity of networking, inclusive and diverse environment, academic learning opportunities, recognition for academic and social commitment, as well as career growth and development opportunities. Deadline of Chancellor’s International Scholarship is 30 April 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: The statement should discuss your ambitions, skills and experience, and why you want to study a particular course or subject. You will need to submit two separate statements; one for university and one for scholarship.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must have applied to any eligible undergraduate or postgraduate taught course at the University of Bristol. For undergraduate, studies in medicine, dentistry and veterinary science are not supported in this scholarship.
Applicant must be applying for a course that is starting in September.

overview: Think Big Awards (Undergraduate and Graduate) are partially-funded scholarships for international students studying in the University of Bristol, UK. It is a university-funded scholarship that contributes to the tuition fee of the selected students. The benefits include undergraduate awards of £6,500 or £13,000 per year, postgraduate awards of £6,500, £13,000, or £26,000 per year, and £3,000 (paid once) to support international students. It is also a great opportunity because it has wide eligibility across disciplines. Scholarship holders also get leadership development training and career accelerator awards (only for select postgraduate students). In these trainings, the students will get to attend workshops, seminars, and many other perks and practice for future success. The deadline for applications to Think Big Awards for Undergraduate level is in February, 2026 and for Graduate level, it is in April, 2026.

requiredDocuments.details: Applicants need to submit referee details of 2 academics. Some departments may request only one reference. However, check details once before applying to your chosen course.

Scanned colored copies of your degree(s) and transcript(s) that you have acquired till date. Attach English translation of documents too (if required). A Levels for Undergraduate and Bachelor’s degree for Postgraduate course.

It should describe your skills, experience and academic achievements and interest in studying your chosen subject/course in 1000 words. It should highlight your motivation behind application. Some courses may include specific requirements.
A scanned copy of IELTS or another equivalent language proficiency test certificate according to the course requirement.
An updated CV that showcases your educational background, work experience, and other achievements (preferably in the chosen field).
Applicants may be required to submit other additional documents according to the specific course they apply for.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Be a citizen of any one of the eligible countries, and currently residing in the home country.
Not be a citizen of Australia, hold permanent residency in Australia or be applying for a visa to live in Australia permanently.
Applicant must have completed 16 years of education.
Five years of relevant work experience in Pakistan.
Applicants must have achieved an IELTS (Academic) score of 6.5 or higher (with no individual band score of less than 6.0) or an equivalent TOEFL or PTE score.
All scholarships must be taken up in the year they are awarded, no extensions applicable.
Return to the home country at the completion of their study for at least two years.

People with a disability who meet the eligibility criteria may submit an application with an IELTS score of 6.0 with no band less than 5.0, but if they are selected, they must re-sit an English Language Proficiency test (to be arranged by Australia Awards – Pakistan) and achieve the required score before they can take up their scholarship.

overview: Australia Awards Scholarships are fully funded scholarships offered by the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade. They aim to contribute to the development needs of Australia's partner countries through educational and developmental assistance provided to the younger generations. It offers different courses in various countries (with appointed universities); for Pakistan, Australia Awards Scholarship offers Master’s degree in numerous fields. You receive many benefits with this scholarship, which includes full tuition fee, return air travel (once), establishment allowance (once at the start of course), contribution to the living expense, an introductory academic program which guides on living and studying in Australia, and health coverage. Some additional benefits that may be awarded include: supplementary academic support, pre-course English training fee, and funding for necessary fieldwork. The deadline for this scholarship falls in April, 2026.

requiredDocuments.details: An attested copy of the passport information page or citizenship proof.

requiredDocuments.document: Completed Development Impact and Linkages Plan (DILP)
requiredDocuments.details: Original completed document that showcases your research in alignment with home countries development goals. It should include clear and effective plan you wish to undertake during your research and studies in Australia (to learn and implement in the home country).
Attested Bachelor’s degree certificates with both sides of degree(s) copied.
Attested Bachelor’s degree transcripts with both sides copied.
An original, detailed CV in reverse chronological order (template will be provided).
Attested IELTS with 6.5 overall band (6.0 in all components), or equivalent TOEFL, PTE results valid as of 1 January, 2027.
Two certified reports for Master’s by Research applicants; one for Master’s by Coursework applicants (template provided).
A certified referee report from a workplace superior such as employer or senior colleagues (template provided).

requiredDocuments.document: No Objection Certificate (Public Sector Applicants Only)
requiredDocuments.details: Public sector applicants must include certified No Objection certificate.
A current employment letter from the organization you presently work with (template provided).
An experience letter or any other evidence that proves your employment history.
Applicants can also submit certificates of special achievement or merit which seem relevant to the course/application (optional).

requiredDocuments.document: Support Evidence from Potential Supervisor (for applicants of Research Master’s degree)
requiredDocuments.details: Evidence (letter or email communication) that the applicant has received in-principle support for their research topic from a potential supervisor at the university.

requiredDocuments.details: Research proposal which includes a proposed methodology, timeline, and a brief literature review.

benefits: Dedicated Space for Work at Ertegun House

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicants can only apply for one of the courses in Humanities Faculty. All eligible courses are provided, some may include integrated studies that are jointly administered with a few other faculties.
If awarded, you cannot use Ertegun Graduate Scholarship with any other internal or external scholarship. Similarly, no current students at Oxford may apply for the scholarship.

overview: The Mica and Ahmet Ertegun Graduate Scholarship Programme is a fully-funded scholarship for Master’s and PhD applicants who wish to study Humanities at the prestigious University of Oxford and have impeccable academic record. It is funded by the Oxford University. Some of the benefits that Scholars can enjoy, include, 100% tuition fee coverage, and grant for living costs (approx. £19,000/year). They also get to enjoy free space at the Ertegun House where they are allowed to do their writings and research on their dedicated desks. They are also entitled to many opportunities to participate in social occasions, lectures, performances and other activities that are arranged expressly for the Scholars. They may also get mentorship from the staff members and academics who can help broaden their horizons. If the scholarship is offered for a course lasting more than one year, the continuation of your scholarship each year is subject to an annual renewal process based on satisfactory academic progress. The deadline for The Mica and Ahmet Ertegun Graduate Scholarship Programme is in between December, 2025 - January, 2026 (each course has a different last date for submission).

requiredDocuments.details: Applicants will be provided with a scholarship statement template (by WWAH) that must be submitted along with the admission application. It includes personal, course, and work details along with a few assessment questions.
Scanned copies of your transcript(s) that you have acquired till date. Attach English translation of documents too (if required).
A scanned copy of IELTS or another equivalent language proficiency test according to the course requirement.

Applicant also needs to send a personal statement according to the word limit advised (different for each course). WWAH will guide you about the requirements of each course’s personal statement/statement of purpose and how to make a lasting impression.

Applicants will also need to submit referee details of 3 academics or professionals. For most departments, two of the references must be academic or more. However, check details once before applied to your chosen course.

Applicant are required to send one or two essays related to their field of study for assessment along with the application. It may or may not be an excerpt from a thesis; check with WWAH to get proper guidance on the requirements for your chosen course.
An updated CV that showcases your educational background, work experience, and other achievements (preferably in the chosen field).

If required, you may need to send a research proposal for your research while studying in the Oxford. It should clearly discuss your chosen topic and research question according to the word limit (varies for each course) required.

benefits: £4,000 to £8,000 Tuition Fee Waiver for Graduates

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must be domiciled in Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, the Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan or Sri Lanka.
Applicant must be classed as an 'overseas' student for tuition fee purposes.

overview: The South Asia Excellence Award is a university-funded scholarship that supports international students who have achieved academic excellence and show passion for studying in their chosen field. It is applicable for students getting admission as ‘self-finance’ in the Bachelor’s and Master’s at the University of Nottingham only; students with external funding are not eligible. This scholarship offers £6,000 tuition fee waiver for undergraduates and £4,000 to £8,000 for graduates. It is a merit-based award that is provided for only 1 year of the total study years. All high-achieving international students from South Asia are eligible to apply for this scholarship. The deadline for applications of South Asia Excellence Award is in March 2026.

requiredDocuments.details: Scanned copies of your degree(s) and transcript(s) that you have acquired till date.
An IELTS 6.0 band at least or another equivalent language proficiency test according to the course requirement.
Applicant also needs to send a personal statement that states their reasons for joining the course/university and how they can use these studies to make a good career for themselves ahead.

At least 2 reference letters will be required for admission in the University of Nottingham. The referees will be contacted by the university when you will provide their details. They must upload their references within the provided deadline.
The applicants who possess relevant work experience (if any), can also attach an experience letter with a signed letterhead.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicants must apply for undergraduate admission to any eligible program at Duke or UNC-Chapel Hill.
Students on a gap year who have already been admitted to Duke University or UNC-Chapel Hill and transfer students are not eligible to apply.

overview: The Robertson Scholars Leadership Program is a fully-funded private scholarship that places merit above all else. If you have a strong academic background and are looking to study a Bachelor’s degree at Duke University or University of North Carolina (UNC) - Chapel Hill, USA, then it is the perfect opportunity for you. This scholarship is open to all applicants worldwide and offers some great benefits. For example, it provides eight semesters of full tuition, room and board, and most mandatory fees for Scholars at Duke and UNC-Chapel Hill. Scholars also get access to generous funding for up to three summer experiences and for up to two semesters of study abroad. The Robertson Scholars Leadership Program has two deadlines. For early decision, you need to apply by 15 October, 2025. For regular decision, you need to apply by 15 November, 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: Applicants need to submit 2 recommendation letters for the scholarship. Additionally, they may need to submit 1-3 recommendation letters to the university for admission process too.

Official transcript(s) from all secondary schools attended, including summer sessions and including any online or distance-education classes. The UCN requires transcripts to be sent directly to their officials by the educational institution. Attach English translation, if required.
International applicants must submit official test scores of an English Language Proficiency test (IELTS, TOEFL, etc.) according to the minimum requirement of each course.

A school report from the school counselor or another teacher is required. They must attest to your skills, aptitude, and other qualities that make you a great candidate for the admission in one of the eligible universities.
For each eligible university, the applicant will be asked to attach essays on the recommended topics with their application. It will include one or more long essays with a few short essay questions.

First-year applicants have the option to self-report SAT and/or ACT scores with their application. Students with 2.8 GPA or above (out of 4.0) are not required to submit a test score. Students with GPA below 2.8 are required to submit either an ACT score of 17 or higher or an SAT score of 930 or higher. International students will be judged accordingly.
Applicants may need to submit additional documents, as required by their specific courses etc.

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Admitted to both MBA and a Master’s Programme
eligibilityCriteria.details: You must be admitted both to a 1+1 MBA partnering programme and to the MBA before being considered for the scholarship (applicants on the waiting list will not be considered).

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Admitted to MBA and a non-listed Master’s Programme
eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicants admitted to both a full-time one-year master’s course that is not currently part of the official list of 1+1 MBA partnering programmes, and to the MBA (as a separate application).

overview: Oxford-Pershing Square Graduate Scholarships are fully-funded scholarships provided by the Said Business School of Oxford for the students who wish to undertake an MBA with a 1+1 partnering programme of their choice. This scholarship is provided to the most outstanding students who repeatedly achieve excellent grades and have professional experience of at least two years in their chosen fields. You must get admission in both your Master’s and MBA degrees to be eligible for the scholarship. If you only get admission in one degree, you may only complete it without any help from the scholarship reward. As for the benefits, it offers 100% tuition fee coverage for both degrees (Master’s & MBA) and grant for living costs of at least £20,780/per year. The scholars can always find better networking and career advancement opportunities if they become part of the Oxford University. The deadline for Oxford-Pershing Square Graduate Scholarship is 7th January, 2026.

requiredDocuments.details: A completed undergraduate degree transcript that details the obtained grades along with the subjects studied throughout the academic years. Attach English translation, if it is not in English already.

Send an updated CV with evidence of career progression and international exposure, as well as ability to show leadership potential. Applicants with experience from a variety of sectors are encouraged to apply.
Detail your post-MBA career plans and demonstrate how the programme will equip you with the skills to reach these goals.

Applicant must have a high level of quantitative and analytical skills evidenced by your GMAT or GRE results. GMAT score above 650 (average score is 680) and GRE verbal and quantitative score of 160 each is considered competitive.

Applicant are required to send one or two brief essay questions related to their field of study for assessment along with the application. Check with WWAH to get proper guidance on the requirements for your chosen course.
Applicants will also need to submit referee details of 2 academics or professionals. Preference is for professional references, but if not available, applicant can submit academic reference instead.

overview: The Oxford Centre for Islamic Studies at the Oxford University offers scholarships to Muslim students who wish to study at Postgraduate level and work for the betterment of the Muslim world or Islamic traditions. The Oxford Centre for Islamic Studies (OCIS) Scholarships are for up to 5 Master’s and PhD students each year who can define clear plans on how their studies will provide benefit in the next decade and how. If the applicants can impress the panel, they may get great benefits such as 100% tuition fee coverage, grant for living costs (at least £19,237), as well as international networking and career advancement opportunities. The scholarship is based on academic merit and financial need. All applicants must receive an offer letter to study in their chosen courses to attain the scholarship. The deadline for Oxford Centre for Islamic Studies Scholarship is the same as their Oxford Course deadline. It will be between December, 2025 and January, 2026 (dependant on each course).

requiredDocuments.details: Applicants will be provided with a scholarship statement template (by WWAH) that must be submitted along with the admission application. It includes a few assessment questions that must be answered.
Scanned copies of your transcript(s) that you have acquired till date. Attach English translation of documents too (if required).
A scanned copy of IELTS or another equivalent language proficiency test according to the course requirement.

Applicant also needs to send a personal statement according to the word limit advised (different for each course). WWAH will guide you about the requirements of each course’s personal statement/statement of purpose and how to make a lasting impression.

Applicants will also need to submit referee details of 3 academics or professionals. For most departments, two of the references must be academic or more. However, check details once before applied to your chosen course.

Applicant are required to send one or two essays related to their field of study for assessment along with the application. It may or may not be an excerpt from a thesis; check with WWAH to get proper guidance on the requirements for your chosen course.
An updated CV that showcases your educational background, work experience, and other achievements (preferably in the chosen field).
For a select few courses, you may need to attach your GRE General Test results for assessment.
If required, you may need to send a brief research proposal for your research while studying in the Oxford.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Be a foreign national (not from China or Taiwan).
Bachelor’s requires an intermediate or equivalent qualification. Postgraduate programs require a bachelor's or master's degree, respectively.
Be of good moral character and have no criminal histories.
Applicants must apply directly to a Taiwanese university or college and complete the admission standards. Obtaining an admission letter is essential for confirming the scholarship.
Applicants should not be registered as student in Taiwan unless graduated this year and are applying for a higher degree. Exchange or dual degree students are also disqualified.

Applicant is ineligible for scholarship if their Taiwan or MOE Huayu Enrichment Scholarship has ever been revoked. Also, if they have taken 5 years of scholarship already, they will be considered ineligible.

overview: The Ministry of Education (MOE) Scholarship provided by the government of Taiwan is a fully-funded scholarship. It is given to students applying for Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD. You can apply to any university in Taiwan and then apply for the scholarship to get it funded. The benefits include tuition fee coverage of NTD 40,000 each semester, living allowance of NTD 15,000 monthly for undergraduate and NTD 20,000 monthly for graduate and doctorate students, Mandarin language training (if required), and opportunity to experience new culture and get mentorship and guidance. The deadline for MOE scholarship is 31 March, 2026.

requiredDocuments.details: A completed application form that has to be submitted to the Taiwan Representative Office.
A photocopy of the applicant’s passport or other documentary evidence of nationality.

requiredDocuments.document: Photocopy of Recent Degree and Transcripts
requiredDocuments.details: A photocopy of their highest academic degree along with the associated academic transcripts. Documents in a language other than Chinese or English must be translated into Chinese or English and the translated documents must be authenticated.

requiredDocuments.document: Photocopies of University Admission or Proof of Application
requiredDocuments.details: Photocopies of documentary evidence that the applicant has already applied to a university in Taiwan (e.g., photocopies of the application fee remittance, the application form, and a notice or email from the university/college acknowledging receipt of the application.)

A photocopy of a language proficiency certificate in Chinese or English. TOCFL Level 3 or higher for Chinese. TOEFL or IELTS for English, as and if required by the course. Language Proficiency must be at least intermediate level or 75% of total score (in principle).
2 reference letters from a principal, a college or university president, professors, and/or supervisors which are personally signed, and placed in sealed envelopes.
Any additional documents specified by the assigned Taiwan Representative Office.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must be a self-funded student who is classified as an 'overseas' or ‘international-fee paying’ student for tuition fee purposes.
Applicant must have applied for a full-time undergraduate course at the University of Warwick starting in Autumn session to be eligible.

overview: Warwick Undergraduate Global Excellence Scholarship is a scholarship that offers full and partial tuition fee waivers to the undergraduate level students who show academic and extracurricular excellence as well as leadership skills. For the recent cycle, there will be up to 15 100% tuition fee awards, up to 170 50% tuition fee awards, up to 100 25% tuition fee awards and up to 10 £2,000 (IFP only) awards. Moreover, the students can get many networking opportunities with professionals, alumni, and other scholars who can play a role in future career development. The talented recipients can also use this opportunity to bring real change in the world. The deadline for Warwick Undergraduate Global Excellence Scholarship is in January, 2026.

requiredDocuments.details: Scanned copies of your degree(s) and transcript(s) that you have acquired till date. Attach English translation of documents too (if required).
An IELTS 6.0 band at least or another equivalent language proficiency test according to the course requirement.

Applicant also needs to send a brief personal statement of max 4000 characters that states their reasons for joining the chosen course and how they can use these studies to make a good career for themselves ahead. It will be split in 3 questions that WWAH will provide you a template for.
Applicants will need one reference letter from a professor or employer who can attest their qualities in maximum 4000 characters. Template will be provided by WWAH.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must be applying for a full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree.
Applicant must be an international student.
The applicant should receive an offer of admission (Unconditional or Conditional English Package Offer) and fulfill conditions by 30 October to be considered eligible for scholarship.

overview: International Scientia Coursework Scholarship is a flagship scholarship of University of New South Wales (UNSW), Australia. It is provided to international students who wish to enroll in a Bachelor’s or Master’s coursework degree, in either fully or partially funded capacity. The successful candidates should possess high academic achievement and leadership skills, as well as show engagement in extracurricular work. The scholarship benefits include a fully or partially funded scholarship. The offer 1 provides 100% tuition fee paid directly to the university for the minimum duration of program, while offer 2 provides $20,000 per annum paid directly towards tuition fees for the minimum duration of program. The scholarship also allows the recipient to get access to many professional development and networking opportunities. Deadline of International Scientia Coursework Scholarship is 30 October, 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: Applicants will need to submit official academic certificates and transcripts they have acquired till date.
A proof of English language proficiency, such as IELTS, TOEFL, or another accepted tests’ result.
Applicants will also need to submit their passport copy or another ID for verification.
The scholarship selection is based on applicant showing extra-curricular and leadership skills. Provide as many certificates that can establish your achievements in various activities.
Some courses/departments may require applicants to share their updated CV along with the application.
Applicants may be required to send a Personal Statement on your reasons and motivation for applying to the program of your choice.
Some courses may request a portfolio of updated projects that showcase specific skills required for the higher studies.

benefits: Provided for Each Term of the Program
Inclusive to Bachelor’s, Master’s, and Diploma Students
Can be Combined with Other Scholarships

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must be applying for a full-time UNSW diploma, undergraduate, or postgraduate coursework degree as a new student except programs offered by AGSM, UNSW Online, UNSW Canberra, UNSW Foundation Programs, Transition Program Online, any program taught in the Hexamester calendar or Study Abroad students.
Applicant must be an international student from an eligible country.
The applicant should have applied and received an offer of admission into the undergraduate or postgraduate degree.

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Not a Current Student at UNSW
eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant should not be a current student at the UNSW to be considered for the scholarship. Only exception are students who have completed an undergraduate degree at the UNSW and are enrolling in postgraduate degree now.

overview: International Scholarship Award is a partially-funded scholarship of University of New South Wales, Australia. It is provided to international students who wish to enroll in a Diploma, Bachelor’s, or a Master’s coursework degree at UNSW, Australia. The scholarship benefits include a partial funding of 15% tuition fee contribution, paid for the duration of the program. It can be combined with other partial scholarships and are awarded on the basis of Personal Statement submitted along with the application.The scholarship also allows the recipient to get access to many professional development and networking opportunities. The deadline of International Scholarship Award is 30 October, 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: Applicants will need to submit official academic certificates and transcripts they have acquired till date.
A proof of English language proficiency, such as IELTS, TOEFL, or another accepted tests’ result.
Applicants will also need to submit their passport copy or another ID for verification.

Applicants are required to send a Personal Statement of 500 words on your reasons and motivation for applying to your chosen program, to be eligible for scholarship. For university application, you may be asked to send another Personal Statement if your course/department requires one.
The scholarship selection is based on applicant showing extra-curricular and leadership skills. Provide as many certificates that can establish your achievements in various activities.
Some courses/departments may require applicants to share their updated CV along with the application.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must be applying for a full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree (in LLB, LLM, or JD).
Applicant must be an international student.
The applicant should receive an offer of admission (Unconditional or Conditional English Package Offer) and fulfill conditions by 30 October to be considered eligible for scholarship.

overview: UNSW Law & Justice International Award is a partially-funded scholarship of University of New South Wales, Australia. It is provided to international students who wish to enroll in a Bachelor’s or Master’s coursework degree in the field of Law. The candidates should possess high academic achievement, leadership skills, and should show engagement in extracurricular work to be considered for the award. Usually, well-rounded individuals are selected who can check all these boxes and show passion to study at the UNSW. The scholarship benefits include a partial funding of $10,000, paid in tuition fee for the first year of degree only. The scholarship also allows the recipient to get access to many professional development and networking opportunities. The deadline of UNSW Law & Justice International Award is 30 October, 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: Applicants will need to submit official academic certificates and transcripts they have acquired till date.
A proof of English language proficiency, such as IELTS, TOEFL, or another accepted tests’ result.
Applicants will also need to submit their passport copy or another ID for verification.
The scholarship selection is based on applicant showing extra-curricular and leadership skills. Provide as many certificates that can establish your achievements in various activities.
Some courses/departments may require applicants to share their updated CV along with the application.
Applicants may be required to send a Personal Statement on your reasons and motivation for applying to the program of your choice.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must be applying for a full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program offered by the UNSW Business School (excluding any program offered by AGSM).
Applicant must be an international student.
Undergraduate applicants should not have undertaken prior tertiary studies before applying to the university.

Must have undertaken an undergraduate articulation pathway qualification from an approved partner institution prior to commencing study at UNSW; OR, completed the UNSW Foundation Studies Commerce or Commerce Actuarial stream prior to commencing study at UNSW.
The applicant should receive an offer of admission (Unconditional or Conditional English Package Offer) and fulfill conditions by 30 October to be considered eligible for scholarship.

overview: UNSW Business School International Pathways Award is a partially-funded scholarship of University of New South Wales, Australia. It is provided to international students who wish to enroll in a Bachelor’s or Master’s coursework degree under the UNSW Business School. The candidates should possess high academic achievement, leadership skills, and should show engagement in extracurricular work to be considered for the award. Usually, well-rounded individuals are selected who can check all these boxes and show passion to study at the UNSW. The scholarship benefits include a partial funding of $15,000, paid in tuition fee for the first year of the program. The scholarship also allows the recipient to get access to many professional development and networking opportunities. The deadline of UNSW Business School International Pathways Award is 30 October, 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: Applicants will need to submit official academic certificates and transcripts they have acquired till date.
A proof of English language proficiency, such as IELTS, TOEFL, or another accepted tests’ result.
Applicants will also need to submit their passport copy or another ID for verification.
The scholarship selection is based on applicant showing extra-curricular and leadership skills. Provide as many certificates that can establish your achievements in various activities.
Some courses/departments may require applicants to share their updated CV along with the application.
Applicants may be required to send a Personal Statement on your reasons and motivation for applying to the program of your choice.

Inclusive to Both Bachelor’s and Master’s Students
Chance to Experience New Culture and Environment

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must be applying for a full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program offered by the UNSW Business School.
Applicant must be an international student.

Undergraduate applicants must have completed an assessable Senior Secondary School qualification immediately prior to commencing study at UNSW and not have undertaken prior tertiary study (diploma, VET, etc).

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Not Receiving UNSW Business School International Pathways Award
eligibilityCriteria.details: The applicant should not be receiving the UNSW Business School International Pathways Award.
The applicant should receive an offer of admission (Unconditional or Conditional English Package Offer) and fulfill conditions by 30 October to be considered eligible for scholarship.

overview: UNSW Business School International Scholarship is a partially-funded scholarship of University of New South Wales, Australia. It is provided to international students who wish to enroll in a Bachelor’s or Master’s  coursework degree under the UNSW Business School. The candidates should possess high academic achievement, leadership skills, and should show engagement in extracurricular work to be considered for the award. Usually, well-rounded individuals are selected who can check all these boxes and show passion to study at the UNSW. The scholarship benefits include a partial funding of $5,000, paid in tuition fee for the minimum duration of the program. The scholarship also allows the recipient to get access to many professional development and networking opportunities. The deadline of UNSW Business School International Scholarship is 30 October, 2025.

requiredDocuments.details: Applicants will need to submit official academic certificates and transcripts they have acquired till date.
A proof of English language proficiency, such as IELTS, TOEFL, or another accepted tests’ result.
Applicants will also need to submit their passport copy or another ID for verification.
The scholarship selection is based on applicant showing extra-curricular and leadership skills. Provide as many certificates that can establish your achievements in various activities.
Some courses/departments may require applicants to share their updated CV along with the application.
Applicants may be required to send a Personal Statement on your reasons and motivation for applying to the program of your choice.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must be classed as an international self-financed student for fee-paying purposes. They cannot hold funding from any other non-repayable alternative source.
Applicant must be holding an offer for an eligible undergraduate degree starting in September.
Applicant must achieve a minimum of AAB at A-level or equivalent qualification to be considered for the scholarship.
Result of any English language proficiency test that is accepted by the university. It can be IELTS (Academic) 6.5 band at least or another equivalent test.

overview: Undergraduate International Excellence Scholarships are offered by the University of Cardiff for international undergraduate students. These are partially-funded scholarships that deduct 50% tuition fee from the total amount. Applicants can get funding for three years. They can either choose any three-year program, or pick four or five years programs and pay the full tuition fee themselves. The scholarship is provided to students who can demonstrate their academic potential and clear future goals. Key benefits of the scholarship include 50% tuition fee reduction, 3 years support, as well as many development and career advancement opportunities. The deadline for the Undergraduate International Excellence Scholarship is in April, 2026. However, applicants should apply to the university earlier to receive an offer first, then apply for the scholarship.

requiredDocuments.details: The applicant should provide all academic certificates and transcripts that can prove their educational history. A Levels students can apply directly for the scholarship and course but Intermediate students should complete a Foundational Program first.
Applicant should send a copy of the passport information page for their profile verification.
A letter of recommendation from a teacher, counselor, or another academic who can attest your skills in writing.
An updated CV that includes your education, work experience, and other relevant experiences and achievements.
You will need to prepare 2 Statements of Purpose, one for admission and the other for scholarship. WWAH will provide you templates for both.
The result of any English language proficiency test that is accepted by the university. It can be IELTS (Academic) 6.5 band at least or another equivalent test.

benefits: Renewable for Four Years (if criteria is met)

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must send a completed application by 1st December to be considered eligible for the scholarship.
When applying for admission to the Boston University, applicant must submit the scholarship essay along with the application to be considered.

overview: Trustee Scholarship is a fully-funded scholarship for Undergraduate students who wish to study their Bachelor’s degree at the Boston University, USA. It is sponsored by the university for exceptionally talented and bright students who achieve an average of 4.0 grade in their high school studies. Furthermore, BU looks for candidates who have potential to reach and achieve success in intellectual and creative fields ahead. The scholarship is awarded to up to 20 students each year. A Trustee Scholarship includes full undergraduate tuition fee, mandatory undergraduate student fees, and can be renewed for four years of studies, if certain maintenance criteria are met. At BU, Trustee Scholars get to be a part of a unique campus community that offers many intellectual, cultural, and social opportunities to explore. The deadline for scholarship is 1st December, 2025. Apply by then to Boston University to be eligible for the scholarship in the next academic year.

requiredDocuments.details: Applicants will be given two scholarship essay prompts, out of which, they must submit one along with the application. It should be max. 600 words and well written.

Applicants will send original or certified copies of their country’s Higher Secondary School certificates and transcripts as part of the application. Attach notarized English translation (if required).
The school counselor/teacher will need to submit the Senior Year grades to the University as soon as possible.

requiredDocuments.document: Counselor Recommendation and School Report Form
requiredDocuments.details: WWAH will provide the School Report form and the School Counselor Recommendation form that must be filled and submitted by the School Counselor.
A teacher also needs to submit the Teacher Evaluation form that goes along with the admission and scholarship application.

Applicants must provide a English Language Proficiency test. Boston university accepts IELTS, TOEFL, and Duolingo tests. For IELTS and TOEFL, applicants should ask their testing service to send the official results to the university directly.

All students who will be studying on an F-1 Student Visa or J-1 Exchange Visitor Visa are required to submit financial documentation. Complete the Finance Statement and submit documents, such as online deposit accounts or a signed bank letter verifying the ability to pay educational expenses.

requiredDocuments.document: Copy of Data Page of Passport
requiredDocuments.details: All international students must submit a photocopy of the photo/data page of their current, valid passport.
Although not required, international applicants are encourage to submit interviews or Glimpse video (60-90 seconds) of themselves to complement the application.

The university does not require result of any standardized tests such as SAT, ACT, etc., but the applicants can choose to self report their scores. They may also ask the testing services to submit the scores of their behalf directed to the BU.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must be eligible to pay the Overseas fee rate and register as a self-finance overseas student.
Applicant must fall under a lower income background category (as defined by the university). Currently, it includes applicants with annual income of £42,875 or less, or its international equivalent.

overview: The UCL Global Master's Scholarship is a partial scholarship funded by the University College London. It encourages international students from lower income backgrounds to pursue full-time taught Master's degree studies at UCL. It is a scholarship with total value of £15,000 (for one year) and if it is a 2 years’ course, the award will be split in half. 50% will be paid in Year 1 and 50% in Year 2. Along with that, it has many other benefits such as, it can be held with other bursaries/scholarships, which must be reported to the Financial Office. It covers tuition fee but if amount is surplus, it can be used for other expenses. The scholarship also offers growth and development opportunities along with chances of networking with peers. The deadline for applications to this scholarship is in May 2026.

requiredDocuments.details: You must provide an official transcript from the Academic Registry or Student Records office at your institution. The transcript must be on institutional-headed paper, stamped and signed by the issuing office, and in English.

Your personal statement should include your personal experiences and how they can help you in future. Also, discuss how UCL and your selected goals can help you advance in your career. It should be within 3000 characters limit (spaces included) with 12-font size and single spaced. It should not exceed 2 sides of the same page.
Applicant must provide a copy of their current passport information page.
Test result of English language proficiency exam if your first language is not English. IELTS 6.5 band with 6.0 in all components or another equivalent test.
Applicant also needs two academic or professional reference letters from referees, which they will upload on the provided link.
GRE and GMAT test results might be required if the course specifically asks for it.
Some courses might require portfolio of work samples, writing samples etc. according to the requirements of the course/field of study.

eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicant must be or under 35 years ( born on or after May 1st, 1990).

eligibilityCriteria.criterion: Studies/Research in Austria Before Application Not Allowed
eligibilityCriteria.details: Applicants must not have studied/pursued research/pursued academic work in Austria in the last six month before taking up the grant.
Applicant can only apply for Master's at the Diplomatic Academy (DA) or the Central European University (CEU) in International Relations.

The descendants of forced labourers under the Nazi regime (regardless of their country of origin) or applicants who come from countries that have exceptionally suffered from the Nazi regime, especially from the recruitment of forced labourers are encouraged to apply.

overview: Scholarship Foundation of the Republic of Austria offers scholarships for Master’s Studies in International Relations. These fully-funded scholarships are only offered at the Diplomatic Academy (DA) and the Central European University (CEU), where funding is provided by the government through OeAD. Each university can accept up to 3 students for the scholarship. This scholarship offers many benefits including Monthly Scholarship Installments of 1,050 EUR, Health Insurance between 55 to 200 EUR (with assistance in getting it), option to book Accommodation with housing office between 300 to 800 EUR (requires administrative fee of 21 EUR/month), and travel allowance (not for EU, EFTA, or OECD member countries). The deadline for this scholarship is May, 2026.

requiredDocuments.details: Fully completed application form “Application for a Scholarship of the Scholarship Foundation of the Republic of Austria”
A CV which includes all details about your education, work experience, accomplishments, and other relevant activities.

Two letters of recommendation, that confirm the necessity of the stay in Austria and provide information about the scientific qualification of the applicant. For these letters of recommendation no specific form is required; they have to contain the letterhead, date and signature of the person recommending the applicant and the stamp of the Institution / university / department and must be no older than six months at the time of application.
The information page of passport showing the name and picture of the applicant.

requiredDocuments.document: Admission/Acceptance Letter From DA or CEU
requiredDocuments.details: Confirmation of admission/acceptance from the Diplomatic Academy (DA) and the Central European University (CEU). Without a confirmation of admission the scholarship cannot be awarded.

requiredDocuments.document: Extra Document(s) for Descendants of Forced Labourers
requiredDocuments.details: Processing number or photocopy of the letter of information from the Austrian "Reconciliation, Peace and Cooperation Fund" or the German Foundation "Remembrance, Responsibility and Future".

requiredDocuments.document: Transcripts and Degree Certificates (for University admission)
requiredDocuments.details: Transcripts and degree certificates of previously completed studies.

requiredDocuments.document: English Language Proficiency Test (for University admission)
requiredDocuments.details: Test results of passed IELTS with 6.5 overall band, TOEFL iBT 88, or another language proficiency test. If applicant has earned previous degree while studying in English, they may send proof of that instead.

A statement of purpose that states your reasons for choosing the program, which courses (elective or compulsory) in the program you are interested to study, and what are your reasons for studying them (study or career-wise).
An essay on a research question which applicant’s would wish to pursue further in their studies.
